用英语介绍一个朋友：她很高，有一头长头发。
ladder.a: She's tall. She has long hair.

items.lesson: Part A What can we see in a community?
lessons: What can we see in a community
items.stem: Tom 这样介绍他的社区，你同意吗？
work: There has a big park in my community.
I often run there with my dog.
right: 说“某个地方有某物”用 there is：
There is a big park in my community.

ladder.q: 补全：____ ____ a shop in my community.（有）
改错：There has a bus stop near my home.
ladder.a: There is a bus stop near my home.

ladder.q: 用英语说：我们社区有一家商店，还有一个公共汽车站。
ladder.a: There is a shop. There is also a bus stop.

items.lesson: Part B What do people do in a community?
lessons: What do people do in a community
items.stem: 我们社区里有两个操场。选出正确的一句。
right: 两个操场是复数：there 后面用 are，playground 加 s。
There are two playgrounds.
typical: There is 说惯了，没看后面是几个：

ladder.q: 补全：There ____ a gym in my community.
补全：There ____ three shops near my home.
用英语说：商店里有很多衣服。
ladder.a: There are many clothes in the shop.

items.lesson: Part A What jobs are important in a community?
items.stem: 介绍叔叔的工作（司机），选出正确的一句。
right: 叔叔是男的，用 he；
一名司机，driver 开头是辅音，用 a：He's a driver.
typical: 汉语“他是司机”，没有“一个”：

ladder.q: 补全：My aunt is ____ nurse.
补全：This is my uncle. ____ is ____ farmer.
用英语问同学：你叔叔是做什么工作的？

items.lesson: Part B How can young people help their community?
lessons: How can young people help their community
items.stem: 看图：在养老院里，Mike 正在扫地。Look! Mike ____ the floor.
right: Look! 说的是此刻正在发生的事：is + sweeping。
Mike is sweeping the floor.
typical: “正在扫地”就是 sweeping the floor：

ladder.q: 补全：Look! Sarah is ____ (read) a story to the kids.
补全：Look! Amy and John ____ washing the windows.
用英语说：看！陈杰正在做饭。

items.lesson: Part A How can the weather be different?
lessons: How can the weather be different
items.stem: 天气预报：北京，晴。用括号里的词填空：It's ____ (sun) in Beijing.
right: 说天气用带 y 的词：sun → sunny；
sun 加 y 之前先双写 n。

ladder.q: 用括号里的词填空：It's ____ (wind) today.
用括号里的词填空：It's ____ (cloud) in Shanghai.
— What's the weather like in Harbin? — ____（下雪）

items.lesson: Part B What do we do in different weather?
lessons: What do we do in different weather
items.stem: 今天下大雪，我们不能去公园。选出正确的一句。
options: We can't go to the park.
We don't can go to the park.
We can't to go to the park.
right: can 的否定就是 can't，后面直接跟动词原形：
We can't go to the park.
typical: We don't can go to the park.

ladder.q: 补全：It's rainy. We ____ play outside.（不能）
改错：It's windy. We can't to play basketball.
ladder.a: It's windy. We can't play basketball.

ladder.q: 用英语说：下雨了，我们不能出去，但可以在家画画。
ladder.a: It's rainy. We can't go out. But we can draw at home.

items.lesson: Part A What do we wear in different seasons?
lessons: What do we wear in different seasons
items.stem: — Do you like your new socks? — Yes! ____（很暖和。）
right: socks 是一双袜子，用 they 指代；
they 后面的 are 不能少：They're warm.
typical: 说东西怎么样，张口就是 It's ...：

ladder.q: 补全：I like this coat. ____ warm.
补全：Look at these shirts. ____ nice.
— Whose socks are these? — 是 Sarah 的。用英语回答。

items.lesson: Part B What do we do in different seasons?
lessons: What do we do in different seasons
items.stem: — Which season do you like? — ____
options: Yes, I do. I like it very much.
Autumn. I can fly a kite.
right: Which season 问的是哪个季节，先说出季节：
Autumn. I can fly a kite.
typical: 听到 do you like 就先说 Yes：
Yes, I do. I like it very much.

ladder.q: — Which season do you like? — ____（夏天）
— Do you like winter? — ____（是的）
用英语问同学喜欢哪个季节，再替他答：秋天，可以去散步。
ladder.a: Which season do you like? Autumn. I can take a walk.

items.lesson: Part A What are your class rules?
items.stem: Amy 给班级做了一块规则牌，你同意这样写吗？
work: Don't late for class!
right: late 不是动作，Don't 后面要先加 be：
Don't be late for class!

ladder.q: 补全班规：Don't ____ in class.（吃东西）
补全班规：Don't ____ late.
写两条班规：别在教室里跑；对人友好（nice）。
ladder.a: Don't run in the classroom. Please be nice.

items.lesson: Part B Why do we follow class rules?
lessons: Why do we follow class rules
items.stem: 今天你值日。你想说“我能扫地”，选出正确的一句。
options: I can to sweep the floor.
right: can 后面直接跟动词原形，前面不加 am，后面不加 to、-ing：
I can sweep the floor.
typical: 听过 He's sweeping the floor.，就照着说：

ladder.q: 选词补全：I can ____ the blackboard.（clean / cleaning）
改错：I can to close the windows.
用 I can 说两件你值日能做的事。
ladder.a: I can turn off the fans. I can clean the desks.（合理即可）

items.lesson: Part A What are your family rules?
items.stem: 妈妈说：吃饭前你得先洗手。选出正确的一句。
options: You have wash your hands first.
You are have to wash your hands first.
You have to wash your hands first.
right: “得、必须”是 have to，后面跟动作：
You have to wash your hands first.
typical: 你 = You，得 = have，洗手 = wash your hands：
You have wash your hands first.

ladder.q: 补全：You have ____ go to bed now.（得睡觉了）
改错：You have tidy your room.
ladder.a: You have to tidy your room.

ladder.q: 用 You have to 说一条你家的家规。
ladder.a: You have to use kind words.（合理即可）

items.lesson: Part B How do family rules help us?
items.stem: — Where is Grandma?　— ____（奶奶在书房）
right: Where 问在哪儿，不用 Yes / No 回答；
Grandma 是女的，用 she：She's in the study.
typical: 问句里有 is，就先答 Yes：

ladder.q: — Where is Dad?　— ____ in the bedroom.
— Where is your sister?　— ____ in the bathroom.
用英语问“John 在哪儿？”，再答“他在客厅”。
ladder.a: Where is John? He's in the living room.

items.lesson: Part B How can a good schedule help us?
items.stem: 下午 5 点，该回家了。选出正确的一句。
options: It's time to go to home.
right: “该做某事了”：It's time to + 动作。
home 前面不加 to：go home。
typical: It's time for lunch 能说，
就说：It's time for go home.

ladder.q: 补全：It's 12 o'clock. It's time ____ lunch.
补全：It's 7 o'clock. It's time to ____ up.
晚上 9 点了，用英语说“该睡觉了”。
ladder.a: It's time to go to bed.（或 It's time for bed.）

items.lesson: Part A What is your schedule?
items.stem: 晚上 8 点 15 分，该怎么写？
right: 中午 12 点以后用 p.m.，晚上 8 点多是 p.m.；
有分钟的时间不加 o'clock：8:15 p.m.

ladder.q: 下午 4 点整，补全：It's 4 ____ .
晚上 9 点 30 分睡觉，写出这个时间。

items.lesson: Part A What do we need to buy?
lessons: What do we need to buy
items.stem: 这条短裤是 Mike 的。选出正确的一句。
right: shorts 按复数说，用 these 和 are：
These shorts are Mike's.

ladder.q: 补全：____ shoes are nice.（这双）
补全：Those socks ____ yours.
用英语问：那条短裤是谁的？

items.lesson: Part B How do we decide what to buy?
lessons: How do we decide what to buy
items.stem: 你想问这双鞋多少钱，选出正确的问句。
right: 问价钱用 how much；
shoes 是复数，用 are：How much are these shoes?

ladder.q: 补全：How much ____ this skirt?
补全：— How much are the socks? — ____ 10 yuan.
用英语问这件夹克多少钱。

items.lesson: Part A What farm animals do you know?
items.stem: Mike 在农场写了这句话，你同意吗？
work: Look! I can see five sheep.
right: sheep 的复数还是 sheep，不加 s：
one sheep，five sheep

ladder.q: 写出复数：one cow → five ____
写出复数：one tomato → two ____
写出复数：one sheep → ten ____　one horse → ten ____

items.lesson: Part B What can we learn on a farm?
lessons: What can we learn on a farm
items.stem: Look at ____ cows over there!
right: cows 是好几头，over there 在远处：
远处的好几个用 those。
typical: cows 是复数，复数就用 these：
Look at these cows over there!

ladder.q: （手里拿着几根胡萝卜）补全：____ are carrots.
（指着远处的一匹马）补全：What's ____ ?
（指着远处的几只鸡）用英语问一问，再答一答。

items.lesson: Part A What can we do on a farm?
lessons: What can we do on a farm
items.stem: 说一说农民们每天在农场做的事（喂猪），选出正确的一句。
right: they 是好几个人，动词用原形，不加 s，
前面也不加 are：They feed the pigs.
typical: 说的是农民的事，动词要加 s：

ladder.q: 选词补全：They ____ apples.（pick / picks）
改错：Farmers plants corn.
用 They 说两件农民在农场做的事。
ladder.a: They water the beans. They feed the cows.（合理即可）

items.lesson: Part B How should we eat?
items.stem: — Would you like a spoon? — ____（不用，我会用筷子）
options: No, I don't. I can use chopsticks.
No, thank you. I can use chopsticks.
No, I can't. I can use chopsticks.
right: Would you like ...? 是客气地问“要不要”，
不要就说 No, thank you.，再说为什么。
typical: 和 Do you like ...? 一样答：

ladder.q: — Would you like some fish? 你想要，回答。
— Do you like fish? 你不喜欢，回答。
想请同桌把盐递给你，用 Can you please ...? 说一句。
ladder.a: Can you please pass me the salt?

items.lesson: Part A How are your friends different?
items.stem: — What's your new classmate like? — ____
right: What's ... like? 问“……是什么样的人”，
要说样子或性格：He's kind and clever.
typical: like 是“喜欢”，就答他喜欢什么：

ladder.q: 补全：— What's Amy like? — She's quiet and ____ .（勤奋的）
哪一句问 Mike 是什么样的人：What does Mike like? / What's Mike like?
用英语问：你的新同学是什么样的人？

items.lesson: Part A How are your friends different?
items.topic: ai 和 ay 的读音
items.stem: 哪个词里有和 rain 中 ai 一样的音？
right: ai 和 ay 读音一样，都读字母 A 的名字 /eɪ/：
rain、wait、tail、day、play、say。
typical: 照拼音 ai 读“爱”，rain 和 my 里的音一样：选 my

ladder.q: 把词按读音分两组：tail　say　cat　train
补全单词（ai 或 ay）：The boy w__ts for the tr__n every d__ .
读生词 mail 和 tray：ai、ay 各读什么音？
ladder.a: 都读字母 A 的名字 /eɪ/

items.lesson: Part B What can you do?
items.stem: Sarah 会跳舞。选出正确的一句。
right: can 后面的动词用原形，主语是谁都不变：
Sarah can dance.
typical: Sarah 是“她”，动词要加 s：

ladder.q: 补全：I can ____ (make) robots.
补全：Robin can ____ (jump) rope.
— Can you sing? — 不会。用英语回答，再说一样你会做的事。
ladder.a: No, I can't. I can ...（如 dance）

items.lesson: Part B What can you do?
items.stem: Zhang Peng 这样写自己会做的事，你同意吗？
work: I can play the piano.
I can play the football, too.
right: 乐器前加 the：play the piano；
球类、棋类前不加 the：play football、play Chinese chess。

ladder.q: 补全（不需要就写 ×）：He can play ____ Chinese chess.
补全（不需要就写 ×）：Binbin can play ____ pipa. Let's play ____ ping-pong.
用英语说：我会弹钢琴，也会打篮球。
ladder.a: I can play the piano. I can play basketball, too.

items.lesson: Part B What can you do?
items.topic: be good at 后接什么
items.stem: Mike is good at ____ basketball.
right: be good at 后面接名词或动词 -ing：
good at playing basketball、good at football。
typical: Mike can play，那 good at 后面也用原形：

ladder.q: 补全：Amy is good at ____ (draw).
补全：Binbin is good at ____ (play) the pipa.
用英语说：Robin 擅长做机器人。
ladder.a: Robin is good at making robots.

items.lesson: Part A How do we express our feelings?
lessons: How do we express our feelings
items.stem: — You look worried. What's the matter? — ____
right: What's the matter? 问“出了什么事”，
要说出遇到的事：I lost my pen.
typical: 对方说我看起来担心，就答 Yes：

ladder.q: — What's the matter? — 我的猫病了。用英语回答。
对方说 My cat is sick. 你该回哪一句：I'm sorry. / That's great!
同学看起来很难过，用英语问他怎么了。
ladder.a: You look sad. What's the matter?

items.lesson: Part A How do we express our feelings?
lessons: How do we express our feelings
items.stem: Amy can't swim. The swimming test is tomorrow. Amy is ____ .
right: Amy 不会游泳，明天就要考，心里担心：
Amy is worried.
typical: 明天就要考了，心里很激动：

ladder.q: Tom breaks my new toy. I'm ____ .（生气的）
My little brother is sick. I'm ____ .（担心的）
用英语说：我爸爸病了，我很担心。
ladder.a: My father is sick. I'm worried.

items.lesson: Part A How do we express our feelings?
lessons: How do we express our feelings
items.topic: ee 和 ea 的读音
items.stem: Lily 这样说，你同意吗？
work: tea 和 see 写法不一样，
但 tea 里的 ea 和 see 里的 ee 读音一样。
right: ea、ee 都读 /iː/：tea、eat、see、sheep。
写的时候要按单词记住用哪一个。

ladder.q: 哪个词的读音和 meet 一样：meat　met　mitt
补全（ee 或 ea）：I can s__ a sh__p. It can __t grass.
读生词 seat 和 feet，它们押韵吗？

items.lesson: Part B How can we understand each other better?
lessons: How can we understand each other better
items.stem: Grandpa is talking. Please listen ____ him.
right: “听某人说”是 listen to sb：
Please listen to him.
typical: 汉语“听他说”不用别的词：

ladder.q: 补全：We should listen ____ the teacher in class.
补全：Let's listen ____ music. Look ____ the picture.
用英语说：请听我说。

items.lesson: Part B How can we understand each other better?
lessons: How can we understand each other better
items.stem: Tom: I'm happy at school. I play with my friends. But I'm sad at home. My dog is sick. Tom 为什么在家难过？
options: His mum is angry with him.
right: 前两句写学校：开心，和朋友玩；
后两句写家：难过，因为 My dog is sick.
typical: 孩子难过，多半是妈妈生气了：
His mum is angry with him.

ladder.q: Tom 在学校感觉怎样？用一个英语词回答。
I'm worried. My cat is lost. 我为什么担心？用中文答。
给 Tom 一条建议，用 You can ... 写一句。
ladder.a: 如 You can help your dog.

items.lesson: Part A What do you learn at school?
lessons: What do you learn at school
items.stem: We have PE ____ Tuesdays.
right: 在星期几用 on：on Tuesdays、on Monday。
at 用在钟点前，in 用在月份、季节前。

ladder.q: 补全：I often read books ____ Saturdays.
补全：I get up ____ 6:30 ____ Mondays.
用英语回答：What do you have on Fridays?（音乐和体育）

items.lesson: Part A What do you learn at school?
lessons: What do you learn at school
items.stem: Amy 这样写自己的课，你同意吗？
work: I have art class
on Thursday afternoons.
right: 说“星期几的上午、下午”，有具体哪一天，用 on：
on Thursday afternoons；只说下午才用 in the afternoon。

ladder.q: 补全：I read books ____ the evening.
补全：We play basketball ____ Monday afternoons.
用英语说：我星期六上午上美术课。
ladder.a: I have art class on Saturday mornings.

items.lesson: Part A What do you learn at school?
lessons: What do you learn at school
items.topic: ie 和 igh 的读音
items.stem: 哪个词里有和 pie 中 ie 一样的音？
right: ie、igh 都读字母 I 的名字 /aɪ/：
pie、lie、tie、high、right、night。
typical: 照拼音 ie 读“耶”，和 yes 开头的音像：选 yes

ladder.q: 把词按读音分两组：tie　big　right　lie
补全（ie 或 igh）：My t__ is on the r__t.
读生词 flight 和 fries：igh、ie 各读什么音？
ladder.a: 都读字母 I 的名字 /aɪ/

items.lesson: Part B What do you do at the weekend?
lessons: What do you do at the weekend
items.stem: — Does your aunt work at the weekend? — ____（是的）
right: 用 Does 问，就用 does 回答：
Yes, she does. / No, she doesn't.

ladder.q: — Does Amy have art class on Fridays? — Yes, ____ .
— Does Zhang Peng cook lunch? — No, ____ .
用英语问 Mike：你爸爸周末工作吗？
ladder.a: Does your father work at the weekend?

items.lesson: Part B What do you do at the weekend?
lessons: What do you do at the weekend
items.stem: My sister ____ her room every Sunday. (tidy)
right: 主语是 My sister（她），动词用三单；
tidy 是辅音 + y 结尾，变 y 为 i 再加 es：tidies。

ladder.q: 写三单形式：cry　play
补全：My brother ____ (study) English at the weekend.
用英语说：她每天收拾她的书桌。
ladder.a: She tidies her desk every day.

items.lesson: Part B What do you do at the weekend?
lessons: What do you do at the weekend
items.stem: 读 Ann 的话：I'm busy, but I do my homework on time. I play ball every day, too. 你同意吗？
work: Ann 很忙，
但她的学习和玩耍很平衡。
right: Ann 虽然忙，但作业按时做完，每天也有时间玩；
学习和玩耍两样都有，就是平衡。

ladder.q: Ann 按时做作业吗？用 Yes 或 No 回答。
Ben: I'm busy. I play football every day. I have no time to study. Ben 平衡好了吗？
给 Ben 一条建议，用 You can ... 写一句。
ladder.a: 如 You can do your homework after dinner.

items.lesson: Part A How can we stay healthy?
items.stem: Amy 这样写健康小贴士，你同意吗？
work: We should to wash our hands.
We should go to bed early.
right: should 后面直接用动词原形，不加 to：
We should wash our hands.

ladder.q: 补全（不需要就写 ×）：You should ____ eat more vegetables.
改错：He should to see a doctor.
用英语说：我们应该多吃水果。

items.lesson: Part A How can we stay healthy?
items.topic: oa 和 ow 的读音
items.stem: 哪个词里有和 slow 中 ow 一样的音？
right: 这里的 ow 和 oa 都读字母 O 的名字 /əʊ/：
slow、snow、goat、coat；how 里的 ow 是另一种读音。
typical: ow 学过，就读 how 里的音：选 how

ladder.q: 把词按读音分两组：snow　cow　coat　now
补全（oa 或 ow）：My new c__t is yell__ .
读生词 toad 和 bowl：oa、ow 各读什么音？
ladder.a: 都读字母 O 的名字 /əʊ/

items.lesson: Part B How can good habits help us?
lessons: How can good habits help us
items.stem: — Can I go out to play now? — No, I'm afraid not. 答话人的意思是：
right: I'm afraid not. 是礼貌地说“恐怕不行”，
开头的 No 已经表明：不可以。

ladder.q: — Can I use your pen? — No, I'm afraid not. 能用吗？
I'm afraid it's too late. 这里的 afraid 是什么意思？
用英语礼貌地拒绝：— Can I have some candy? —

items.lesson: Part B How can good habits help us?
lessons: How can good habits help us
items.stem: Sam 总是很晚才睡觉。选出给他的建议。
options: You don't should go to bed so late.
You shouldn't go to bed so late.
You shouldn't to go to bed so late.
right: should 的否定是 shouldn't，后面直接接动词原形：
You shouldn't go to bed so late.
typical: You don't should go to bed so late.

ladder.q: 补全：You ____ watch TV so often.（不应该）
改错：He doesn't should eat so much candy.
ladder.a: He shouldn't eat so much candy.

ladder.q: 用英语给建议：你不应该吃太多冰激凌，你应该多吃水果。
ladder.a: You shouldn't eat too much ice cream. You should eat more fruit.

items.lesson: Part A What do we eat?
items.stem: 选出最合适的回答：— What would you like to drink? — ____
right: What would you like ...? 问“想要什么”，
要说出想要的东西：I'd like some water.

ladder.q: 补全：— What would you like to eat? — I'd like some ____ .（饺子）
— Would you like some soup? — ____（不要）
— What's your favourite food? — 面条，很好吃。用英语回答。

items.lesson: Part A What do we eat?
items.topic: would like 后接 to do
items.stem: My dad would like ____ noodles.
right: would like 后面接动作，要用 to + 动词原形：
would like to eat noodles。
typical: “想吃”就是 would like 加 eat：

ladder.q: 补全：What would you like ____ (drink)?
补全：Lily would like ____ (eat) some fish.
用英语问 Oliver：你想吃什么？
ladder.a: What would you like to eat?

items.lesson: Part A What do we eat?
items.stem: Tom 这样说，你同意吗？
work: cook 和 cool 里都有 oo，
所以 oo 的读音一样。
right: oo 有两种读音：book、cook、good、foot 读短音 /ʊ/；
too、cool、zoo、food 读长音 /uː/。

ladder.q: 把词按 oo 的读音分两组：foot　moon　wood　food
哪个词的 oo 和 look 读音一样：food　book　moon
读生词 wood 和 pool：oo 各读长音还是短音？

items.lesson: Part B Where does our food come from?
lessons: Where does our food come from
items.stem: — Where does the tea come from? — ____
right: 主语是 it，动词用三单：It comes from Yunnan.
问句里有 does，come 不变；答句没有 does，要加 s。
typical: 问句里是 come，就照着用：

ladder.q: 补全：— Where does the orange come from? — It ____ from Guangxi.
补全：Oliver ____ (come) from Australia.
用英语问：这些胡萝卜是从哪里来的？
ladder.a: Where do these carrots come from?

items.lesson: Part B Where does our food come from?
lessons: Where does our food come from
items.stem: 白萝卜：我们吃的是它的哪个部分？用一个英语单词写出来。
right: 白萝卜我们吃的是长在地下的根：root；
上面的绿梗是 stem，叶子是 leaves。
typical: 萝卜长长的一根，是 stem：

ladder.q: 用英语写出植物的这几个部分：根、茎、叶、种子
玉米：我们吃的是它的哪个部分？用英语答。
用英语说：我们吃芹菜的茎，不吃它的根。
ladder.a: We eat the stem of celery, not the root.

items.lesson: Part A What is exciting about nature?
items.stem: 山里有一些湖。选出正确的一句。
options: There have some lakes in the mountains.
There are some lakes in the mountains.
There is some lakes in the mountains.
right: 说“某处有某物”用 there is / there are；
lakes 是好几个，用 are。
typical: There have some lakes in the mountains.

ladder.q: 补全：There ____ a small river near my home.
补全：There ____ many birds in the forest.
用英语说：树上有一些鸟，树旁有一条河。
ladder.a: There are some birds in the tree. There is a river near it.

items.lesson: Part A What is exciting about nature?
items.topic: 回答 Is there 问句
items.stem: — Is there a lake near your home? — ____（有）
right: 问句用 Is there，回答也用 there is：
Yes, there is.（末尾不缩写）
typical: Is it ...? 答 Yes, it is，
这句也这样答：Yes, it is.

ladder.q: 补全：— Is there a lake in the park? — No, ____ .
补全：— Are there any tall trees here? — Yes, ____ .
用英语问：森林里有河吗？
ladder.a: Is there a river in the forest?

items.lesson: Part A What is exciting about nature?
items.topic: walk 里的 l 读不读
items.stem: Kate 这样说，你同意吗？
work: walk 里有字母 l，
读的时候要把 l 读出来。
right: walk、talk 里的 l 不发音：walk /wɔːk/；
all、tall、wall 里的 l 要读出来。

ladder.q: 哪个词里的 l 不发音：tall　talk　small
读一读，说出共同的音：draw　August　walk
读生词 chalk 和 hall：l 读不读出来？

items.lesson: Part B What happens in bad weather?
items.stem: 明天会有大雪。选出正确的一句。
right: 将来“会有”用 there will be，
will 后面用原形 be：There will be heavy snow.

ladder.q: 补全：There will ____ strong winds tomorrow.
改错：There will is snow this weekend.
ladder.a: There will be snow this weekend.

ladder.q: 用英语说：今天晚上会有大雾。
ladder.a: There will be heavy fog tonight.

items.lesson: Part B What happens in bad weather?
items.stem: 这里常常下大雨。选出正确的一句。
options: There is often big rain here.
There is often strong rain here.
There is often heavy rain here.
right: 英语说“大雨”“大雪”用 heavy：heavy rain、heavy snow；
“大风”才说 strong winds。
typical: There is often big rain here.

ladder.q: 补全：We can't go out. There is ____ snow.（大雪）
补全：There are ____ winds today.（大风）
用英语说：明天会有大雨和大风。
ladder.a: There will be heavy rain and strong winds.

items.lesson: Part B What happens in bad weather?
items.stem: In the desert there is little water. 这句话的意思是：
right: little 加水这类数不清的东西，表示“很少，几乎没有”；
a little 才是“有一点”。
typical: little 是“一点”，就是有一点水：

ladder.q: I'd like a little ice cream. 他想要冰激凌吗？
There is little food at home. 家里吃的多不多？
用英语说：杯子里的水很少了。
ladder.a: There is little water in the cup.

items.lesson: A Let's learn
items.stem: I usually eat breakfast ____ 7:00 ____ the morning.
right: 钟点前用 at：at 7:00；
上午、下午、晚上前用 in：in the morning。

ladder.q: 补全：I go to bed ____ 9:00.
补全：I do my homework ____ the evening.
用英语回答：When do you get up?（6:30）

items.lesson: A Let's talk
items.stem: — When do you usually eat dinner? — ____
right: When 问“什么时候”，要答出时间：
Usually at 7 o'clock.（钟点前用 at）
typical: 听到 eat dinner 就答在哪儿吃：

ladder.q: — When do you get up? — ____（6:30）
给答句提问：I go to bed at 9:30.
ladder.a: When do you go to bed?

ladder.q: 用英语问 Pedro：你们在西班牙几点吃午饭？
ladder.a: When do you eat lunch in Spain?

items.lesson: A Let's spell
items.stem: 全班跟读 plate。哪种读法对？
options: 读成 po-late，p 后加个音
p、l 连着读，中间不加音
读成 pate，l 没读出来
right: pl 是两个辅音挨在一起，要连着读：
p 一出口马上滑到 l，plate 只有一个音节。
typical: 像拼音那样给 p 配个韵母：

ladder.q: 拍手数音节：clock、play、please
圈出含 cl 或 pl 的词：class, cake, people, pen
Please play with the clock. 里有几个词含 cl 或 pl？

items.lesson: B Let's talk
items.stem: — What do you do on the weekend? — ____
right: What 问做什么，不用 Yes / No 回答；
I often + 动词原形：I often play ping-pong.

ladder.q: 补全：I ____ go shopping with my mum.（经常）
改错：I'm usually wash my clothes on Sundays.
ladder.a: I usually wash my clothes on Sundays.

ladder.q: 用英语回答：What do you do on the weekend?（说两件事）
ladder.a: 如：I often watch TV. Sometimes I cook.

items.lesson: B Let's learn
items.stem: “周末我常和妈妈去购物。”哪句对？
options: I often go to shopping with my mum.
I often go shop with my mum.
I often go shopping with my mum.
right: “去购物”是固定说法 go shopping，
go 后面直接跟 -ing 形式，不加 to。

ladder.q: 补全：Let's go ____ (swim) this afternoon.
填 to 或不填：I go ____ school. I go ____ shopping.
用英语说：我星期天常去散步。
ladder.a: I often go for a walk on Sundays.

items.lesson: B Read and write
items.stem: 读完 Robinson 的信，Tom 这样说。你同意吗？
work: 信里的 Friday 说的是星期五。
right: 信里说 His name is Friday.——Friday 是朋友的名字。
名字和星期首字母都大写，要看上下文。

ladder.q: Friday likes swimming. 这里的 Friday 是谁？
I play with Friday on Fridays. 哪个是人，哪个是日子？
ladder.a: with Friday 是人，on Fridays 是日子

ladder.q: My dog's name is Sunday. I walk Sunday every day. 第二个 Sunday 指什么？

items.lesson: A Let's talk
items.stem: “我最喜欢冬天。”哪句对？
right: best（最）放在句末：I like winter best.
问句 Which season do you like best? 也是 best 在最后。

ladder.q: 连词成句：best / I / spring / like
改错：I like best summer.
用英语问同学最喜欢哪个季节，再写出你的回答。
ladder.a: Which season do you like best? I like … best.

items.lesson: A Let's learn
items.stem: “夏天我每天都能去游泳。”哪句对？
options: I can going swimming every day in summer.
I can go swimming every day in summer.
I can go swimming every day on summer.
right: can 后面用动词原形：can go swimming；
季节前用 in：in summer。

ladder.q: 补全：It's cold ____ winter.
补全：I can ____ (make) a snowman in winter.
用英语说：春天我能放风筝。
ladder.a: I can fly kites in spring.

items.lesson: A Let's spell
items.stem: brown, library, grapes, umbrella, brother 里有几个词含 br？
right: brown、brother 的 br 在词首；
library、umbrella 的 br 在词中，也算：共 4 个。

ladder.q: 圈出含 gr 的词：green, girl, grow, angry
补全单词：um____ella（雨伞）　li____ary（图书馆）
写出两个 br 在词中间的单词。

items.lesson: B Let's talk
items.stem: 说说你为什么喜欢春天，选出正确的一句。
options: Because it's warm, so I like spring.
I like spring because is warm.
I like spring because it's warm.
right: because 和 so 只用一个；
because 后面要有主语：because it's warm。
typical: Because it's warm, so I like spring.

ladder.q: 补全：— Why do you like winter? — ____ I like snow.
改错：Because it's hot, so I don't like summer.
用 because 说一句：我最喜欢秋天，因为天气凉爽。
ladder.a: I like autumn best because it's cool.

items.lesson: B Let's learn
items.stem: “秋天我常去摘苹果。”哪句对？
options: I often pick apple in autumn.
I often pick apples in autumn.
I'm often pick apples in autumn.
right: 摘的苹果不止一个，用复数 apples；
often 后面直接跟动词：I often pick apples.

ladder.q: 补全：I often plant ____ in spring.（flower）
改错：In winter I'm often make a snowman.
ladder.a: In winter I often make a snowman.

ladder.q: 用英语说：春天我们常去野餐。
ladder.a: We often go on a picnic in spring.

items.lesson: B Read and write
items.stem: In fall, apples fall from the trees. 两个 fall 各是什么意思？
options: 前一个“秋天”，后一个“落下”
right: in fall：在秋天，fall 和 autumn 意思一样；
apples fall：苹果落下，是动作。
typical: 在落下的时候，苹果落下来

ladder.q: I like fall best. 这里的 fall 是什么意思？
Look! The leaves fall from the tree. 这里的 fall 呢？
用 fall 的两个意思各说一句英语。
ladder.a: 如：Snow falls in winter. / I love fall.

items.lesson: A Let's talk
items.stem: 学校的郊游在五月。选出完全正确的一句。
options: The school trip is in may.
The school trip is in May.
The school trip is on May.
right: 月份的首字母大写：May；
只说月份用 in：in May。
typical: The school trip is in may.

ladder.q: 改正书写：the english party is in april.
ladder.a: The English party is in April.

ladder.q: 补全：Tree Planting Day is ____ March 12th.
用英语回答：When is Children's Day?
ladder.a: It's in June.（也可以说 It's on June 1st.）

items.lesson: A Let's learn
items.stem: — When is Tree Planting Day? — ____（3 月）
right: 英语每个月都有自己的名字：3 月是 March；
Tree Planting Day 在 3 月：It's in March.

ladder.q: 补全：Children's Day is in ____ .（6 月）
用英语回答：When is Mother's Day?

items.lesson: A Let's spell
items.topic: sh 和 ch 的拼写
items.stem: 写出“鱼”的英文单词。
right: fish 的结尾是 sh：f-i-sh；
sh 读时嘟嘴、气流长；ch 先堵一下再放开。

ladder.q: 填 ch 或 sh：___eep（绵羊）　lun___（午饭）
填 ch 或 sh：___irt（衬衫）　tea___er（老师）
写出：中国　短裤

items.lesson: B Let's talk
items.stem: — What will you do for your teacher on Teachers’ Day? — ____
options: I will to make a card.
right: will 后面跟动词原形：I'll make a card.
I'll = I will，说“将要做”的事。
typical: 学过 want to，就加 to：
I will to make a card.

ladder.q: 补全：I’ll ____ (sing) a song for her.
改错：I will cooking for my mother.
ladder.a: I will cook for my mother.

ladder.q: 用英语说：我将给老师画一幅画。
ladder.a: I’ll draw a picture for my teacher.

items.lesson: B Let's learn
items.stem: Lily 这样说，你同意吗？
work: 中秋节有时在九月，有时在十月。
right: 中秋节按农历算（八月十五），每年的公历日期不同，
所以说 usually in September or October。

ladder.q: Spring Festival 每年都在同一天吗？
ladder.a: 不是：按农历算，在 January 或 February

ladder.q: China’s National Day 每年都在 October 1st 吗？
用英语回答：When is Mid-Autumn Day?
ladder.a: It's usually in September or October.

items.lesson: B Read and write
items.stem: Art Party｜WHEN: June 6th｜WHERE: Gym｜RSVP: by May 30th　When is the party?
right: WHEN 后面的 June 6th 是聚会的日子；
RSVP: by May 30th 是“5 月 30 日前回复”。

ladder.q: RSVP: by April 20th. 是什么意思？
ladder.a: 4 月 20 日前回复来不来

ladder.q: Sports Meet｜WHEN: Oct. 15th｜RSVP: by Oct. 8th. When is the sports meet?
给你的生日聚会写一行 WHEN 和一行 RSVP。

items.unit: Unit 4 When is the art show?
items.lesson: A Let's talk
items.stem: — When is the maths test? — It’s ____ June 9th.
right: 具体某一天（几月几号）前用 on：on June 9th；
只说月份才用 in：in June。

ladder.q: 补全：The singing contest is ____ March 2nd.
补全：We have a school trip ____ October.
用英语回答：When is Teachers’ Day?

items.unit: Unit 4 When is the art show?
items.lesson: A Let's learn
items.stem: My birthday is on May ____ .（5 月 3 日）
right: 日期用序数词：third，缩写是 3rd；
1st、2nd、3rd 特殊，从 4th 起才是 th。

ladder.q: 写缩写：first ____　second ____
写缩写：fourth ____　fifth ____
用英语回答：When is the school trip?（6 月 2 日）

items.unit: Unit 4 When is the art show?
items.lesson: A Let's spell
items.stem: Tom 这样说，你同意吗？
work: this 和 three 都有 th，但读音不一样。
right: three、thin、maths 的 th 读时声带不振动；
this、mother、brother 的 th 读时声带振动。

ladder.q: 把 th 的读音分两组：thin, this, three, that
哪个词的 th 和 mother 一样：maths 还是 brother？
His brother is thirteen. 哪个词的 th 读时声带振动？

items.unit: Unit 4 When is the art show?
items.lesson: B Let's learn
items.stem: My birthday is on December 12th. 把 12th 写成英文单词。
right: twelve 变序数词：把 ve 换成 f，再加 th：
twelve → twelfth

ladder.q: 写出英文单词：1st ____　2nd ____　3rd ____
写出英文单词：5th ____　9th ____
写出英文单词：12th ____　20th ____

items.unit: Unit 4 When is the art show?
items.lesson: B Let's talk
items.stem: — When is your birthday? — ____（8 月 9 日）
right: 问 your，答 my：My birthday is …
具体日子前用 on：on August 9th。

ladder.q: — When is your birthday? — ____ birthday is on June 2nd.
— When is your mother's birthday? — ____ birthday is on May 9th.
问 Amy 的生日，再替她回答（2 月 14 日）。
ladder.a: When is your birthday? My birthday is on February 14th.

items.unit: Unit 4 When is the art show?
items.lesson: B Read and write
items.stem: Sarah 的日记写着 April 26th。怎么读？
right: 日期读序数词：26th = twenty-sixth；
两位数只变最后一个词：twenty 不变，six → sixth。
typical: 两个部分都变成序数词：

ladder.q: 写出读法：April 21st
写出读法：May 23rd
写出读法：March 30th

items.lesson: A Let's learn
items.stem: — Whose dog is it? — It's ____ .（我的）
right: “我的”后面没有名词时用 mine：It's mine.
也可以说 It's my dog.，my 后面要跟名词。

ladder.q: 补全：This is my book. It's ____ .
补全：— Is that Amy's pen? — Yes, it's ____ .
用英语回答：Whose pictures are these?（是他们的）

items.lesson: A Let's talk
items.stem: — Whose kite is it? — It’s Zhang Peng’s. It’s ____ .
right: Zhang Peng 是男孩，“他的”用 his；
It’s Zhang Peng’s. = It’s his.

ladder.q: 补全：It's Amy's book. It's ____ .
补全：These are Wu Binbin’s pictures. They’re ____ .
用英语说：那幅画是陈洁的，是她的。
ladder.a: That picture is Chen Jie's. It's hers.

items.lesson: A Let's spell
items.stem: 哪个词结尾的读音和 long 的结尾一样？
right: long、sing 都以 ng 结尾：舌根抬起，鼻子出声；
think 后面还有 k，thin 的 n 是舌尖音。

ladder.q: 把词分两组：sing, pink, ring, ink
填 ng 或 nk：thi___（想）　thi___（东西）
写出：一枚粉色的戒指

items.lesson: B Let's talk
items.stem: 小狗 Fido 是男孩（he）：I often go for a walk with ____ .
right: with 后面用 him：go for a walk with him；
he 用来说谁在做事：He’s eating.
typical: I often go for a walk with he.

ladder.q: 补全：I like Mike. I often play with ____ .
补全：This is Amy. Can you help ____ ?
用英语说：我能给他一些水吗？
ladder.a: Can I give him some water?

items.lesson: B Let's learn
items.stem: Mike is ____ in the park.（run）写出正确形式。
right: run 是“辅音 + 一个元音 + 辅音”的短词，
先双写 n 再加 -ing：running。

ladder.q: 写 -ing 形式：swim ____　sit ____
写 -ing 形式：jump ____　sleep ____
补全：The rabbits are ____ (run). The cat is ____ (climb).

items.lesson: B Read and write
items.stem: Robin 在动物园说：I’m jumping like a rabbit. 意思是：
options: Robin 喜欢跳，也喜欢兔子。
right: 这里的 like 是“像……一样”，不是“喜欢”；
I’m jumping：跳的是 Robin 自己。
typical: Robin 喜欢跳，也喜欢兔子。

ladder.q: I’m sleeping like a cat. 谁在睡？
I’m singing like a bird. 是什么意思？
用英语说：我像熊猫一样吃东西。

items.lesson: A Let's learn
items.stem: Look! The children ____ lunch now.
right: “正在做”= am / is / are + 动词 -ing；
children 是复数，用 are：are eating。

ladder.q: 补全：Listen! Amy ____ (sing).
补全：— What are they doing? — They ____ (read) books.
用英语说：我们正在安静地写作业。

items.lesson: A Let's talk
items.stem: Sarah 这样写，你同意吗？
work: Look! The cat is washing it's face.
right: “它的脸”用 its：washing its face。
it's 是 it is，washing it is face 说不通。

ladder.q: 填 its 或 it's：The dog is sleeping in ____ house.
填 its 或 it's：____ time for lunch.
填 its 或 it's：Look at the dog! ____ playing with ____ ball.

items.lesson: A Let's spell
items.stem: 写出“什么时候”这个英文疑问词。
right: when 以 wh 开头：w-h-e-n；
what、where、when、whose 都是 wh 开头的疑问词。
typical: 听到 w 的音就只写 w：

ladder.q: 补全：___ere（哪里）　___at（什么）
写出：谁的
用 when 问一句，再回答。
ladder.a: 如：When is your birthday? It's on May 2nd.

items.lesson: B Let's talk
items.stem: 在图书馆里，提醒同学小声说话：
right: 说话的样子用 quietly：Talk quietly.
要说“人要安静”才用 quiet：Be quiet!

ladder.q: 补全：Shh! Work ____ , please.（quiet）
补全：Be ____ ! The baby is sleeping.（quiet）
用英语说：请在教室里安静地读书。
ladder.a: Please read quietly in the classroom.

items.lesson: B Let's learn
items.stem: 楼梯口的牌子：Keep to the right. 意思是：
right: right 在这里是“右边”；
keep to the right：一直靠右边走，不是拐弯。

ladder.q: That's right! 这里的 right 是什么意思？
Raise your right hand. 这里的 right 是什么意思？
上下楼梯时，该提醒同学说哪句英语？

items.lesson: B Read and write
items.stem: — Are you drawing a picture? — ____
right: Are you …? 用 am 回答：Yes, I am.
简略回答句末不能缩写成 I'm。
typical: I am 可以缩成 I'm：

ladder.q: — Are you cooking rice? — No, ____ .
— Is Robin doing kung fu? — Yes, ____ .
— Are they making sushi? — Yes, ____ .

items.lesson: Part A What famous places do you know?
lessons: What famous places do you know
items.stem: — How was your holiday? — ____
options: Yes, it was. I climbed a hill.
It is great! I climb a hill.
It was great! I climbed a hill.
It was great! I was climb a hill.
right: How was ...? 问过得怎么样，先说感受：It was great!
说假期里做的事，动词用过去式：I climbed a hill.
typical: 问句里有 was，就先答 Yes：
Yes, it was. I climbed a hill.

ladder.q: — How was your trip? — ____（很棒）
补全：I ____ (visit) my grandma last Saturday.
用英语问朋友周末过得怎样，再替他答：很好，我踢了足球。
ladder.a: How was your weekend? It was good. I played football.

items.lesson: Part B What makes a trip special?
items.topic: Where did you go 怎么答
items.stem: — Where did you go last weekend? — ____
options: We had some yummy hotpot there.
I went to Hangzhou with my aunt.
I go to Hangzhou with my aunt.
Yes, I did. I went to Hangzhou.
right: Where 问去了哪里，先答地点；
说过去的事用 went：I went to Hangzhou.
typical: 听到 did you，就先答 Yes：
Yes, I did. I went to Hangzhou.

ladder.q: — Where did you go yesterday? — ____（去了公园）
— What did you do there? — ____（我们看了一场表演）
用英语问朋友：去年冬天去了哪里？在那儿做了什么？
ladder.a: Where did you go last winter? What did you do there?

items.lesson: Part A What famous places do you know?
lessons: What famous places do you know
items.stem: 用括号里的词填空：Tom ____ (walk) around the old town last Sunday.
right: last Sunday 说的是过去的事，
walk 加 ed：Tom walked around the old town.
typical: Tom 是一个人，动词加 s：
Tom walks around the old town.

ladder.q: 用括号里的词填空：We ____ (watch) a show yesterday.
用括号里的词填空：My cousins ____ (climb) Mount Tai last summer.
用英语说：上个暑假我们参观了一座博物馆。
ladder.a: We visited a museum last summer.

items.lesson: Part B What makes a trip special?
items.stem: 用括号里的词填空：We ____ (see) many clay warriors in Xi'an last summer.
right: last summer 是过去；see 是不规则动词，
过去式是 saw：We saw many clay warriors.
typical: 过去式就在后面加 ed：

ladder.q: 写出过去式：eat → ____，go → ____
用括号里的词填空：I ____ (take) a trip to Wuhan last May.
用英语说：我们吃了热干面，还拍了很多照片。
ladder.a: We ate hot dry noodles and took many photos.

items.lesson: Part A How can festivals bring us together?
lessons: How can festivals bring us together
items.stem: — Did you and your cousins eat jiaozi at the Spring Festival? — ____
right: Did 开头的问句，用 did 回答；
问的是 you and your cousins（你们），答的人说 we：Yes, we did.
typical: Do you ...? 用 do 答，这里也一样：

ladder.q: — Did you clean the house? — No, ____ .
— Did your sister paste fu on the door? — Yes, ____ .
用英语问同学：儿童节你去公园了吗？再替他否定回答。
ladder.a: Did you go to the park on Children's Day? No, I didn't.

items.lesson: Part A How can festivals bring us together?
lessons: How can festivals bring us together
items.topic: 用 Did 问过去的事
items.stem: 用英语问：国庆节你去看望爷爷奶奶了吗？
right: 问过去做没做某事：Did + 主语 + 动词原形？
Did you visit your grandparents?
typical: 说过去的事，动词要用过去式：

ladder.q: 补全：____ you watch the Spring Festival Gala?
变成问句：They watched the fireworks.
用英语问朋友：中秋节你们赏月了吗？
ladder.a: Did you watch the moon at the festival?

items.lesson: Part B How can big events bring us together?
lessons: How can big events bring us together
items.stem: Tom 读自己写的日记，这样判断。同意吗？
work: Our class came first in the relay race!
有感叹号，所以这句是 Opinion。
right: 我们班接力赛得了第一，这件事能查证，是 Fact；
Opinion 是个人的看法，如 Relay races are so exciting!

ladder.q: Fact 还是 Opinion？The race began at nine.
Fact 还是 Opinion？Dragon boat races are the most fun!
写一句关于运动会的 Fact，再写一句 Opinion。
ladder.a: 如：We ran a race. It was great fun!

items.lesson: Part B How can big events bring us together?
lessons: How can big events bring us together
items.stem: — How was the sports meet? — It was great. — What did you like about it? — ____
options: Yes, I did. I liked it a lot.
It was fun. I was very happy.
right: What did you like about it? 问喜欢它的哪一点，
说出具体的事：I liked watching the races.

ladder.q: 补全：I liked ____ (sing) with my friends.
— What did you like about the book fair? — ____（喜欢听作家讲故事）
ladder.a: I liked listening to the writer.

ladder.q: 用英语说说你参加过的一次活动：怎么样？喜欢哪一点？
ladder.a: 如：It was great. I liked playing games.

items.lesson: Part A How do we know we are ill?
lessons: How do we know we are ill
items.stem: Tom has a bad cold. He should ____ a doctor.
right: should 后面直接跟动词原形，
主语是谁都不变：He should see a doctor.
typical: 主语是 he，动词加 s：

ladder.q: 补全：You should ____ (wear) warm clothes.
补全：She is angry. She should ____ (take) a deep breath.
朋友为考试担心，用 should 给他一个建议。
ladder.a: 如：You should ask your teacher for help.

items.lesson: Part A How do we know we are ill?
lessons: How do we know we are ill
items.stem: 用英语说：Mike 发烧了。
right: 说得了什么病用 have / has；
Mike 是一个人，用 has：Mike has a fever.

ladder.q: 补全：I ____ a bad cold.
补全：My sister ____ a cough.
用英语说：我弟弟咳嗽，还发烧。
ladder.a: My brother has a cough and a fever.

items.lesson: Part B How can we stay healthy?
items.stem: 补全：We need ____ enough water every day.
right: need 后面跟动作要加 to，
to 后面用动词原形：We need to drink enough water.
typical: 和 We should drink 一样：

ladder.q: 补全：We should ____ (sleep) well.
补全：You need ____ (eat) healthy food.
用 need to 给爱熬夜的朋友一个建议。
ladder.a: 如：You need to go to bed early.

items.lesson: Part B How can we stay healthy?
items.stem: Tom 这样说，你同意吗？
work: Health is only about our body.
Feeling happy is not part of it.
right: 健康不只是身体不生病，也包括心情好；
心情不好时，可以找家人朋友说一说，做做运动。

ladder.q: 哪件事让心情变好？A. stay up late  B. have fun with friends
朋友说 I'm feeling down. 用英语给他一个建议。
ladder.a: 如：You can talk to your family.

ladder.q: 用两句英语说怎样过健康的生活：一句关于身体，一句关于心情。
ladder.a: 如：I run every morning. I talk to my friends.

items.lesson: Part A Why do we use money?
items.stem: 补全：I ____ a new schoolbag with my pocket money.（打算买）
right: 打算做某事：am / is / are + going to + 动词原形。
I am going to buy a new schoolbag.
typical: I going to buy a new schoolbag.

ladder.q: 补全：We ____ going to buy some fruit.
补全：She is going to ____ (have) a haircut.
— What are you going to do this weekend? — 去买几本书。
ladder.a: I'm going to buy some books.

items.lesson: Part B How can we use money wisely?
lessons: How can we use money wisely
items.stem: 用括号里的词填空：Lucy ____ (buy) a comic book every Sunday.
right: every Sunday 说的是常做的事，用一般现在时；
主语 Lucy 是一个人，动词加 s：buys。
typical: 前面一直在说过去的事：
Lucy bought a comic book every Sunday.

ladder.q: 用括号里的词填空：He ____ (save) money every week.
用括号里的词填空：Tom ____ (walk) to the shop every Saturday.
填空：Last Sunday she ____ (buy) a book. Every Sunday she ____ (save) ten yuan.

items.lesson: Part B How can we use money wisely?
lessons: How can we use money wisely
items.stem: 问一问：Lucy 每周都存钱吗？选出正确的问句。
options: Do she save money every week?
Does she save money every week?
Does she saves money every week?
Is she save money every week?
right: 主语是 she，问句用 Does 开头；
有了 does，动词用原形：Does she save ...?
typical: she 后面的动词要加 s：
Does she saves money every week?

ladder.q: 补全：— Does he write a spending plan? — Yes, ____ .
变成问句：She buys books with her pocket money.
ladder.a: Does she buy books with her pocket money?

ladder.q: 变成否定句：Tom waits for a sale.
ladder.a: Tom doesn't wait for a sale.

items.lesson: Part A Why do we use money?
items.stem: Lily 这样说，你同意吗？
work: I paid 30 yuan for a haircut.
I paid for a service, not goods.
right: 理发是别人为你做的事，是 service；
书包、食物这些买回家的东西才是 goods。

ladder.q: goods 还是 service？a home delivery
goods 还是 service？a pair of sunglasses
用英语各说一句：你用钱买的一样 goods、付钱的一项 service。
ladder.a: 如：I buy books. I pay for haircuts.

items.lesson: Part B What do we know about Earth and its neighbours?
items.stem: 用英语说：他们乘飞船去空间站。
options: They go to the space station by a spaceship.
They take a spaceship go to the space station.
They go to the space station in a spaceship.
They go to the space station in spaceship.
right: 坐在飞船里去：in a spaceship，a 不能少；
用 by 说方式时不加 a：by bus、by plane。
typical: “乘飞船”就是 by + 一艘飞船：
They go to the space station by a spaceship.

ladder.q: 补全：My dad goes to work ____ car.
改错：We went to Shanghai by a plane.
ladder.a: We went to Shanghai by plane.

ladder.q: 用英语说：航天员乘飞船回到地球。
ladder.a: Astronauts come back to Earth in a spaceship.

items.lesson: Part A What can we see in the sky?
lessons: What can we see in the sky
items.stem: 哪一句说得对？
options: The Sun travels around Earth every day.
right: Earth 是行星，绕着太阳转；
月球是地球的邻居，绕着地球转。
typical: 每天看到太阳东升西落：
The Sun travels around Earth every day.

ladder.q: 补全：Mars is a ____ . It goes around the Sun too.
补全：The Moon travels around ____ .
用英语说两句：太阳是恒星；地球绕着太阳转。
ladder.a: The Sun is a star. Earth travels around the Sun.

items.lesson: Part A What can we see in the sky?
lessons: What can we see in the sky
items.stem: 补全：Look up! ____ is big and round tonight.
right: 月亮只有一个，大家都知道指哪个，
前面用 the：the Moon，同样说 the Sun。
typical: A Moon is big and round tonight.

ladder.q: 补全：____ Sun is very hot.
补全：I can see ____ plane and some birds.
用英语说：今天早上太阳很亮。
ladder.a: The Sun is very bright this morning.

items.lesson: Part B What do we know about Earth and its neighbours?
items.stem: — Is there any soil on the Moon? — ____
right: Is there ...? 用 there is / there isn't 回答；
soil 不可数，用 is：Yes, there is.

ladder.q: — Is there a river near your school? — No, ____ .
补全：There ____ a rover on Mars.
用英语问：火星上有树吗？再替对方否定回答。
ladder.a: Are there any trees on Mars? No, there aren't.

items.lesson: Part B What do we know about Earth and its neighbours?
items.stem: 用括号里的词填空：In space, a taikonaut ____ (wash) his face with a wet cloth.
right: 主语 a taikonaut 是一个人，动词用三单；
wash 以 sh 结尾，加 es：washes。

ladder.q: 用括号里的词填空：She ____ (brush) her teeth every morning.
用括号里的词填空：He ____ (watch) the sunrise in space.
用括号里的词填空：Every afternoon the taikonaut ____ (do) exercise.

items.lesson: Part A Where do we get energy?
items.stem: 补全：We use solar power ____ our homes.（给家里供暖）
right: 用某样东西做某事：use ... to + 动词原形，
We use solar power to heat our homes.
typical: We use solar power heat our homes.

ladder.q: 补全：We use electricity ____ (light) our rooms.
补全：We can use wind power ____ (run) trains.
用英语说：我们用水能来发电。
ladder.a: We use water power to make electricity.

items.lesson: Part A Where do we get energy?
items.stem: Solar power is green energy. 这里的 green 是什么意思？
options: 它发出的光是绿颜色的
right: green energy 指清洁、对地球好的能源；
太阳能来自阳光，不是植物，也不是绿颜色的。
typical: 它发出的光是绿颜色的。

ladder.q: 说出课上学的三种 green energy。
ladder.a: wind power, solar power, water power

ladder.q: Green energy is green in colour. 对吗？
用英语说：风能是绿色能源，因为它很干净。
ladder.a: Wind power is green energy because it is clean.

items.lesson: Part B How do we save energy?
items.stem: Amy 这样说，你同意吗？
work: I keep my toys in an old shoe box.
That's reuse.
right: 旧鞋盒没送去回收，换个用法再用，是 reuse；
送去回收、做成新东西，才是 recycle。

ladder.q: reuse 还是 recycle？Use an old jar as a vase.
reuse 还是 recycle？Put old newspapers in the recycling bin.
用英语各说一个 reuse 和 recycle 的做法。
ladder.a: 如：Reuse old boxes. Recycle old books.

items.lesson: Part B How do we save energy?
items.stem: Class is over. 补全：Let's ____ the lights before we go.
right: 关掉电灯、电视这些用电的东西用 turn off；
Let's turn off the lights before we go.
typical: Let's close the lights before we go.

ladder.q: 补全：Turn ____ the computer when you finish.（关掉）
补全：It's dark. Let's turn ____ the light.（打开）
用英语给家人一条节约用电的建议。
ladder.a: 如：We should turn off the TV.

items.lesson: Part A
items.stem: Wu Binbin is 12. John is 11. Wu Binbin is ____ than John.
right: 说岁数的“大”“小”用 older / younger；
big 说的是个头大：Wu Binbin is older than John.
typical: Wu Binbin is bigger than John.

ladder.q: 补全：I'm 12. You're 11. I'm ____ than you.
用英语说：我妹妹比我小。
ladder.a: My sister is younger than me.

ladder.q: 用英语说：Mike 比我大，也比我高。
ladder.a: Mike is older and taller than me.

items.lesson: Part B
items.stem: I'm 45 kg. You're 48 kg. You're ____ than me.
right: 有 than，要用比较级；
heavy 以“辅音字母 + y”结尾，把 y 改成 i 再加 er：heavier。

ladder.q: 补全：I'm 1.5 m. You're 1.6 m. You're ____ (tall) than me.
补全：This film is ____ (funny) than that one.
用英语说：我比我姐姐小两岁。
ladder.a: I'm two years younger than my sister.

items.lesson: Part C
items.stem: 用括号里的词填空：My schoolbag is ____ (big) than yours.
right: big 以“辅音 + 一个元音 + 辅音”结尾，
双写末尾的 g 再加 er：big → bigger。

ladder.q: 写出比较级：fat ____　thin ____
写出比较级：sad ____　short ____
补全：Summer is ____ (hot) than spring. The days are ____ (long).

items.lesson: Part C
items.stem: Tom 比 Ben 高 5 厘米。Tom is ____.
right: 相差多少放在比较级前面：
Tom is 5 centimetres taller than Ben.
typical: 照汉语“高 5 厘米”的顺序：
Tom is taller 5 centimetres than Ben.

ladder.q: 用英语说：我比你高 3 厘米。
用英语说：Mike 比 John 重 2 千克。
ladder.a: Mike is 2 kilograms heavier than John.

ladder.q: 用英语说：我哥哥比我大三岁。
ladder.a: My brother is three years older than me.

items.lesson: Part A
items.stem: 小林这样写，你同意吗？
work: Did you watched TV last night?
right: 问句已经用 did 表示过去了，
后面的动词用原形：Did you watch TV last night?

ladder.q: 补全：— Did you clean your room? — Yes, ____ .
变成问句：She washed her clothes.
变成否定句：I saw a film yesterday.
ladder.a: I didn't see a film yesterday.

items.lesson: Part B
items.stem: 用括号里的词填空：I ____ (see) a panda at the zoo last weekend.
right: last weekend 说的是过去，动词用过去式；
see 是不规则动词：see → saw。

ladder.q: 写出过去式：watch ____　clean ____
写出过去式：go ____　read ____　have ____
用英语说：上周末我读了一本书，还洗了衣服。
ladder.a: I read a book and washed my clothes last weekend.

items.lesson: Part B
items.stem: Amy 这样写上周日的事，你同意吗？
work: It rained last Sunday.
We didn't go to the park.
right: didn't 已经表示过去，后面的动词用原形：
didn't go，写得对。

ladder.q: 补全：I ____ (not watch) TV yesterday.
变成否定句：She cleaned her room.
用英语说：昨天我感冒了，所以没去上学。
ladder.a: I had a cold, so I didn't go to school yesterday.

items.lesson: Part C
items.stem: 用括号里的词填空：The baby ____ (cry) all night, so Mum was very tired.
right: 后半句用了 was，说的是过去的事，动词用过去式；
cry 是“辅音字母 + y”结尾，改 y 为 i 再加 ed：cried。

ladder.q: 写出过去式：study ____　worry ____
写出过去式：stay ____　study ____
补全：Yesterday Amy ____ (study) for her test, then she ____ (play) the piano.

items.lesson: Part A
items.stem: 补全：Tom ____ off his bike yesterday. Now his foot hurts.
right: yesterday 说的是过去，fall 的过去式是 fell：
Tom fell off his bike yesterday.
typical: 把 fall 和 feel 的过去式记混了：
Tom felt off his bike yesterday.

ladder.q: 写出过去式：fall ____　feel ____
写出过去式：ride ____　hurt ____
用英语说：昨天我从马上摔了下来，但我感觉还好。
ladder.a: I fell off a horse yesterday, but I felt OK.

items.lesson: Part B
items.stem: 补全：Last winter, I ____ to Harbin with my family.
right: Last winter 说的是过去，go 的过去式是 went：
I went to Harbin with my family.

ladder.q: 写出过去式：ride ____　eat ____
补全：— Where did you go? — I ____ (go) to Beijing.
用英语说：去年夏天我去了新疆，还骑了马。
ladder.a: Last summer I went to Xinjiang and rode a horse.

items.lesson: Part B
items.stem: 陈杰这样写，你同意吗？
work: Last summer we went to Beijing.
We went there by train.
right: there 本身就是“到那里”，前面不加 to：
went there，就像 go home 一样。

ladder.q: 补全（不需要就写 ×）：I went ____ home at 5 o'clock.
补全（不需要就写 ×）：We went ____ the park yesterday.
— How did you go there? — 我们坐公共汽车去的。用英语回答。

items.lesson: Part C
items.stem: 补全：Last Sunday my friends and I went hiking. We ____ very tired after that.
right: 说过去怎么样用 was / were；
主语 we 是复数，用 were：We were very tired.
typical: We was very tired after that.

ladder.q: 补全：My winter holiday ____ great.
补全：The beaches in Sanya ____ beautiful.
用英语说：昨天我很累，但我的朋友们很开心。
ladder.a: I was tired yesterday, but my friends were happy.

items.lesson: Part A
items.stem: Forty years ago, there ____ no buses in Grandpa's village.
right: 说过去“有”用 there was / there were；
buses 是复数，用 were。

ladder.q: 补全：There ____ a big tree in front of my old house.
补全：Now there ____ many trees on the playground.
用英语说：以前我家附近没有公园，现在有两个。
ladder.a: There was no park near my home. Now there are two.

items.lesson: Part B
items.stem: 补全：Before, I ____ like cats. Now I love them.
right: like 是动作词，过去的“不”用 didn't + 原形：
Before, I didn't like cats.

ladder.q: 补全（wasn't / didn't）：Before, I ____ tall.
补全（wasn't / didn't）：Before, I ____ wear glasses.
用英语说：以前我不喜欢冬天，因为我不会滑冰。
ladder.a: I didn't like winter because I couldn't ice-skate.

items.lesson: Part C
items.stem: 小林这样写变化，你同意吗？
work: The tree was small five years ago.
Now it was very tall.
right: Now 说的是现在，第二句要用现在时：
Now it is very tall.

ladder.q: 补全：It was a seed. Now it ____ a big tree.
补全：There ____ no trees here before. Now there ____ many.
用英语说：以前我的猫很小，现在它很胖。
ladder.a: My cat was small before. Now it is fat.

items.lesson: Section A How do you greet people?
items.topic: 字母前用 a 还是 an
items.stem: 字母前用 a 还是 an？依次填空：____ F，____ U，____ H
right: 看第一个音，不看字母：F /ef/、H /eɪtʃ/ 以元音开头，用 an；
U /juː/ 以辅音 /j/ 开头，用 a。
typical: F、H 不是元音字母，用 a；U 是元音字母，用 an

ladder.q: 填 a 或 an：____ orange，____ ruler
填 a 或 an：____ hour，____ UFO

items.lesson: Section B How do you start a conversation?
lessons: How do you start a conversation
items.stem: 你叫 Lucy。新同学问：How do you spell your name? 你怎么回答？
right: How do you spell ...? 问的是“怎么拼写”，
要一个字母一个字母地拼出来：L-U-C-Y, Lucy.
typical: 听到 your name，就回答名字：

ladder.q: 给问句选答语：What's your name?　A. P-E-T-E-R.　B. I'm Peter.
—How do you spell "Lily"? —____
补全问句：—____ ____ ____ ____ your name? —G-R-E-E-N, Green.

items.lesson: Section A What do you have?
items.stem: 小明这样说，你同意吗？
work: cap 后面加上 e，就成了 cape。
e 不发音，所以 a 的读音不变。
right: 结尾的 e 不发音，但它让前面的 a 读字母 A 的名字。
cap 里的 a 和 cat 一样；cape 里的 a 和 cake、name 一样。

ladder.q: 圈出 a 读字母 A 名字的词：cat　cake　bag　name
哪个词里的 a 和 face 里的 a 读音一样：bag　make　hand
用拼读规则读生词 gate：a 像 cat 里的，还是像 cake 里的？

items.lesson: Section B Where do you put your things?
lessons: Where do you put your things
items.stem: —Where ____ my keys? —____ on the sofa.
right: keys 是复数：问句用 are，
答句用 they 指代：They're on the sofa.
typical: 问句用了 are，答句还是 It's：
—Where are my keys? —It's on the sofa.

ladder.q: Where ____ (be) your books?
—Where's my hat? —____ on the bed.
—Where are your pencils? —____ in my pencil box.

items.lesson: Section A What is fun in a yard?
lessons: What is fun in a yard
items.topic: not 和 note 里的 o
items.stem: 小明这样说，你同意吗？
work: note 和 not 里都有字母 o，
所以 o 都读字母 O 的名字 /əʊ/。
right: not 里 o 后面只跟一个辅音、没有 e，o 读短音 /ɒ/；
note 词尾有不发音的 e，o 才读字母 O 的名字 /əʊ/。

ladder.q: 圈出 o 读 /ɒ/ 的词：box　joke　hot　home
哪个词里的 i 和 big 里的 i 读音一样：nine　six　like
用拼读规则读生词 hop 和 hope：o 各读什么？

items.lesson: Section B What is fun on a farm?
lessons: What is fun on a farm
items.stem: 用括号里的词填空：On the farm, I can see six ____ (sheep) and ten ____ (cow).
right: sheep 单复数同形，几只都写 sheep；
cow 是规则变化，复数加 s：cows。

ladder.q: two ____ (duck) and three ____ (horse)
many ____ (sheep) and some ____ (chicken)
five ____ (child) and twenty ____ (sheep)

items.lesson: Section A How do we get to know each other?
lessons: How do we get to know each other
items.stem: This is my friend. ____ name is Mike.
right: name 前要用形容词性物主代词：he → his。
His name is Mike.（他的名字叫迈克。）
typical: He's 就像 Tom's，表示“他的”：

ladder.q: ____ (she) name is Gina.
—What's ____ (you) name? —____ (I) name is Tom.
填 He's 或 His：____ my brother. ____ name is Bob.

items.lesson: Section B What do we need to know about a new friend?
lessons: What do we need to know about a new friend
items.topic: 并列主语后的 be 动词
items.stem: 回帖介绍自己和朋友：My friend and I ____ both 13 years old.
right: My friend and I 是两个人，相当于 we，
be 动词用 are：My friend and I are both 13 years old.
typical: My friend and I am both 13 years old.

ladder.q: Lily and Lucy ____ (be) from the UK.
My cousin and I ____ (be) from Xi'an.
改错：My sister and I is good friends.

items.lesson: Section A What is your family like?
items.stem: 向同学介绍你的两个哥哥，哪句对？
right: these 指两个以上：be 动词用 are，
名词也要用复数：These are my brothers.
typical: “这些是我的哥哥”，“哥哥”不用变：

ladder.q: Those ____ (be) my parents.
These are my ____ (sister).
改成复数句：This is my friend.

items.lesson: Section A What is your family like?
items.stem: 小明把 He has a soccer ball. 改成一般疑问句。他从第几步开始错？
work: 句中没有 be 动词，要借助助动词 do
主语 he 是三单，用 Does，放在句首
has 照抄：Does he has a soccer ball?
回答：Yes, he does. / No, he doesn't.
right: 用了 Does，后面的动词还原成原形：has → have。
Does he have a soccer ball?

ladder.q: ____ your sister ____ (have) a tennis ball?
改成一般疑问句：Jim likes bananas.
改成否定句：Lucy has a ping-pong bat.
ladder.a: Lucy doesn't have a ping-pong bat.

items.lesson: Section B What do you like about your family?
lessons: What do you like about your family
items.stem: “她是长头发。”哪句对？
right: 描述头发用 have/has；
hair 指一头头发时不可数：She has long hair.

ladder.q: My brother ____ short curly hair.
My father ____ tall and he ____ a big nose.
—What does she look like? —She's thin and ____ (wear) glasses.

items.lesson: Section A What is your school like?
items.stem: 小明想说“我家附近有一个公园”。他这样写，你同意吗？
work: There has a park near my home.
right: 说“某处有某物”用 there be，不用 have/has：
There is a park near my home.

ladder.q: ____ ____ a bank on Green Street.
—____ ____ any restaurants near here? —Yes, there are.
My town ____ (have) two big parks.

items.lesson: Section B What fun things do you do at school?
lessons: What fun things do you do at school
items.stem: The science building is across from the library. 这句话的意思是：
options: 穿过图书馆就到科学楼
right: across from 表示“在……对面”，说的是位置：
科学楼和图书馆面对面，中间隔着路或空地。
typical: 所以是：穿过图书馆就到科学楼。

ladder.q: 填 next to 或 across from：我和 Li Ming 并排坐。I sit ____ Li Ming.
体育馆在礼堂对面。The gym is ____ the school hall.
用英语说：图书馆在体育馆和食堂之间。
ladder.a: The library is between the gym and the dining hall.

items.lesson: Section A Why do you like this subject?
lessons: Why do you like this subject
items.stem: Science is hard for me, ____ I like it a lot.
right: “难”和“很喜欢”意思相反，
表示转折用 but：Science is hard for me, but I like it a lot.
typical: Science is hard for me, and I like it a lot.

ladder.q: I like PE ____ it's exciting.
I want to play, ____ I have a lot of homework.
I have PE ____ IT on Friday. I like IT ____ it's fun, ____ PE is my favourite.

items.lesson: Section B What can you learn from different subjects?
lessons: What can you learn from different subjects
items.topic: let 后面的代词和动词
items.stem: Our IT teacher ____ the computers after class.
right: lets 后面用宾格 us，再直接接动词原形：
lets us use（让我们用）。
typical: “让我们去用电脑”，两个动词之间加 to：
Our IT teacher lets us to use ...

ladder.q: Let ____ (we) go to the music room.
Our PE teacher lets us ____ (choose) the games.
Mum doesn't let ____ (he) ____ (watch) TV after 9:00.

items.lesson: Section A How do you choose a school club?
lessons: How do you choose a school club
items.stem: My sister ____ the piano very well.
right: can 是情态动词，没有人称变化，
后面直接跟动词原形：can play。
typical: 主语 my sister 是三单，动词加 s：
My sister can plays the piano.

ladder.q: He can ____ (swim) very well.
改成一般疑问句：Tom can speak English.
—Can your brother play chess? —No, he ____.

items.lesson: Section B What can you learn in a school club?
lessons: What can you learn in a school club
items.stem: Mia 想加入烹饪社，她写道：I'm good at ____ dumplings.
right: at 是介词，后面接名词或动词 -ing：
I'm good at making dumplings.

ladder.q: She is good at ____ (swim).
I'm interested in ____ (draw) animals.
Are you good at ____ (run)? Join our running club!

items.unit: Unit 6 A Day in the Life
items.lesson: Section A How do you spend your school day?
lessons: How do you spend your school day
items.topic: 时间介词 in 与 on
items.stem: 小红说下面这句话写得对。你同意吗？
work: We have P.E. on Friday afternoon.
right: 说具体某一天的上午、下午、晚上用 on，
on Friday afternoon 没错，小红说得对。

ladder.q: We have music ____ Monday.
I do my homework ____ the evening.
The school trip is ____ the morning of May 2nd.

items.unit: Unit 6 A Day in the Life
items.lesson: Section A How do you spend your school day?
lessons: How do you spend your school day
items.stem: 用括号里的词填空：Tom usually ____ (go) to school at 7:30 and ____ (watch) TV after dinner.
right: 主语 Tom 是三单，动词要变；
以 o、ch 结尾的加 es：goes，watches。
typical: “他去上学”和“我去上学”一样，不用变：go，watch

ladder.q: She ____ (do) her homework at six.
My father ____ (have) breakfast at 7:00.
Tom and his brother ____ (brush) their teeth at 9:00.

items.unit: Unit 6 A Day in the Life
items.lesson: Section B How different are people's daily routines?
lessons: How different are people's daily routines
items.topic: 用 past 和 to 说时间
items.stem: Timo 的下午课 2:15 结束。2:15 用英语怎么说？
right: 英语先说分钟，再说钟点：15 分钟是 a quarter；
刚过 2 点用 past：a quarter past two（也可说 two fifteen）。

ladder.q: 用 past 说 6:30
用 to 说 4:45
Timo 7:40 起床，用 to 说这个时间

items.lesson: Section A How do we celebrate birthdays?
items.stem: 想问“这条短裤多少钱”，哪句对？
right: 问价钱用 How much；
shorts 总是复数形式，要用 these 和 are。

ladder.q: How much ____ (be) the green sweater?
—How much are the socks? —____ two dollars.
How much ____ (be) this pair of trousers?

items.lesson: Section A How do we celebrate birthdays?
items.stem: 写出序数词：nine → ____，twelve → ____
right: nine 去掉 e 再加 th：ninth；
twelve 把 ve 变成 f 再加 th：twelfth。
typical: 序数词就是在后面加 th：nineth，twelveth

ladder.q: five → ____
twenty → ____
写成单词：22nd，31st

items.lesson: Section B How do you make your birthday meaningful?
lessons: How do you make your birthday meaningful
items.topic: 日期前用 on 还是 in
items.stem: 小红在回帖里写了这句话，她说写得对。你同意吗？
work: My birthday is on 9th October.
right: 说到具体的某一天用 on：on 9th October；
只说月份才用 in：in October。所以小红写得对。

ladder.q: My birthday is ____ May.
Teachers' Day is ____ 10th September.
We eat birthday noodles ____ the morning of my birthday.

items.lesson: Section A Why do you like animals?
items.stem: “因为熊猫可爱，所以我喜欢它们。”哪句对？
options: I like pandas because they're cute.
Because pandas are cute, so I like them.
I like pandas because they cute.
right: because 和 so 只能用一个；
because 后面要跟完整的句子：because they're cute。
typical: Because pandas are cute, so I like them.

ladder.q: 用 so 改写：I like koalas because they're cute.
ladder.a: Koalas are cute, so I like them.

ladder.q: —____ do you like elephants? —Because they're smart.
用 because 说一句：我不喜欢狮子，因为它们很吓人。
ladder.a: I don't like lions because they're scary.

items.lesson: Section B How are animals part of our lives?
lessons: How are animals part of our lives
items.topic: What is it like 问什么
items.stem: 动物帖子提纲里有 What does it look like? 和 What is it like?。哪一句该写在 What is it like? 下面？
options: It's huge and has large ears.
right: What is it like? 问性格、脾气：kind、playful；
问长相要说 What does it look like? 答 huge、large ears。
typical: What is it like? 里有 like，就写长相：
It's huge and has large ears.

ladder.q: What does it look like? 问的是长相还是性格？
补全：—What ____ the dog ____? —It's friendly and playful.
补全：—What ____ the giraffe ____ ____? —It's tall with a long neck.

items.lesson: Section A What rules do we follow?
items.stem: 小明给班级写了一条规则。你同意这样写吗？
work: Don't late for class.
right: late 是形容词，不能直接跟在 Don't 后面，
要加 be：Don't be late for class.

ladder.q: Don't ____ (run) on the stairs.
Don't ____ noisy in the library.
Don't ____ (forget) your homework, and don't ____ late.

items.lesson: Section B How can rules help us?
items.stem: “每天早上，Alice 必须先遛狗。”Every morning, Alice ____ the dog first.
right: 主语 Alice 是三单，用 has to；
to 后面的动词用原形：has to walk。
typical: Alice 是三单，两个词都变：
Alice has to walks the dog first.

ladder.q: We ____ (必须) wear the school uniform.
Tom ____ (必须) wear a helmet when he rides a bike.
改错：She must to keeps her phone in the locker.

items.lesson: Section A How often do you do sport or exercise?
lessons: How often do you do sport or exercise
items.stem: —Is this your ruler? —Yes, it's ____.
right: 空后面没有名词，要用名词性物主代词：
mine = my ruler。Yes, it's mine.

ladder.q: This pencil isn't ____ (I). It's Tom's.
—Is this Jenny's eraser? —Yes, it's ____.
My pen is red. ____ (你的) is blue.

items.lesson: Section A How often do you do sport or exercise?
lessons: How often do you do sport or exercise
items.topic: 对 Twice a week 提问
items.stem: —____ do you exercise? —Twice a week.
right: Twice a week 说的是“多久一次”，问频率用 how often；
how long 问多长时间，答语像 For an hour.
typical: 汉语问“多久”，就用 how long：

ladder.q: —____ does he go to the movies? —Once a month.
—____ do you sleep every night? —About eight hours.
—How ____ times a week do you play tennis? —Three times.

items.lesson: Section B How is exercise good for us?
lessons: How is exercise good for us
items.stem: —Their team plays well. —Yes, but ____ is strong too!（我们的队）
right: 空后面没有名词，用名词性物主代词：
ours = our team。…but ours is strong too!

ladder.q: —Is this your bat? —Yes, it's ____.（我的）
Their skateboards are new, but ____ are old.（我们的）
改错：This app isn't Jenny's. Her's is blue.

items.lesson: Section A What do we like to eat?
lessons: What do we like to eat
items.topic: 请人吃喝：some 还是 any
items.stem: 服务员这样问客人。小红说这句话没有错，你同意吗？
work: Would you like some soup?
right: 请对方吃、喝，盼着对方说“要”时，疑问句用 some。
问“有没有”时常用 any：Do you have any soup?

ladder.q: I'd like ____ beef noodles, please.
Are there ____ tomatoes in the fridge?
—Can I have ____ juice, please? —Sure.

items.lesson: Section A What do we like to eat?
lessons: What do we like to eat
items.stem: “我喜欢香蕉和面包。”哪句对？
right: 泛指一类可数的东西用复数：bananas；
bread 不可数，不加 s。

ladder.q: Do you like ____ (apple)?
I have some ____ (milk) for breakfast.
My brother likes ____ (strawberry) and ____ (rice).

items.lesson: Section B How do we make healthy eating choices?
lessons: How do we make healthy eating choices
items.topic: too many 还是 too much
items.stem: 小明写同学的不良饮食习惯。你同意这样写吗？
work: Tom eats too much cookies.
right: cookies 是可数名词复数，要用 too many：Tom eats too many cookies.
too much 用在不可数名词前：too much sugar。

ladder.q: Don't eat too ____ hamburgers.
Fast food often has too ____ salt.
改错：I drink too many juice and eat too much eggs.
ladder.a: many juice → much juice；much eggs → many eggs

items.lesson: Section A What are you doing right now?
lessons: What are you doing right now
items.stem: Listen! Mary ____ in her room.
right: Listen! 提示事情正在发生，用现在进行时：
am/is/are + 动词-ing：Mary is singing.

ladder.q: Look! The boys ____ (play) soccer.
—What ____ you ____ (do)? —I'm reading.
写 -ing 形式：swim，write，sit

items.lesson: Section B How do we share our lives with others?
lessons: How do we share our lives with others
items.stem: It's rush hour in New York. Look! Many people ____ for the subway now.
right: people 是复数，be 动词用 are；
Look! 和 now 说此刻，用 are waiting。
typical: people 没有 s，当成一个人：
Many people is waiting for the subway.

ladder.q: The children ____ (play) in the park now.
Look! Some people ____ (eat) hot pot.
改错：Look! The people is dancing in the square.

items.lesson: Project Draw a group of flats
items.stem: — Where's Flat 201? — ____（在二楼）
right: “第二层”用 second，不用 two；
在某一层楼用 on：It's on the second floor.

ladder.q: 补全：Flat 101 is on the ____ floor.（一楼）
补全：My grandparents live ____ the third floor.
用英语说：我们住在五楼。
ladder.a: We live on the fifth floor.

items.lesson: Section A What’s the weather like?
items.topic: usually 与 now 的时态
items.stem: Tom usually ____ to school. It's raining today. Look! He ____ for the bus now.
right: usually 说平时的习惯，用一般现在时：walks；
Look! 和 now 说此刻正在发生，用现在进行时：is waiting。
typical: 学了进行时，两个空都用 be + -ing：
Tom is usually walking to school.

ladder.q: In Harbin, it often ____ (snow) in winter.
Look! It ____ (snow) outside now.
My dad usually ____ (drive) to work, but now he ____ (ride) a bike.

items.lesson: Section B How do we feel about the weather?
lessons: How do we feel about the weather
items.stem: 爬山时 Helen 发帖写了这句。有人说这句写得对，你同意吗？
work: Although it's foggy, we're still enjoying the climb.
right: although 已经表示“虽然”，后面不能再加 but；
这句写得对。也可以说：It's foggy, but we're still …

ladder.q: 用 although 连接：It's raining. We're still playing.
ladder.a: Although it's raining, we're still playing.

ladder.q: 用 but 改写：Although I'm tired, I feel happy.
ladder.a: I'm tired, but I feel happy.

ladder.q: 改错：Although it's cold, but they're skating.

items.lesson: Section A What was your special day like?
lessons: What was your special day like
items.stem: —____ you ____ any horses on the farm? —Yes, I did.
right: 实义动词的过去时问句：Did + 主语 + 动词原形，
Did you see any horses?
typical: 过去的事，动词用过去式：

ladder.q: ____ you ____ (go) to the zoo yesterday?
改成一般疑问句：She took many photos.
改成否定句：They visited a fire station.
ladder.a: They didn't visit a fire station.

items.lesson: Section B What did you learn on that special day?
lessons: What did you learn on that special day
items.stem: 填空：Yesterday the farmer ____ (teach) us how to ____ (water) the plants.
right: yesterday 说过去：teach 是不规则动词，过去式 taught；
how to 后面用动词原形：to water。
typical: 昨天的事，动词全改成过去式：
taught us how to watered the plants

ladder.q: Last week we ____ (go) to a farm.
We wanted to ____ (pick) some strawberries.
The farmer ____ (show) us how to ____ (cut) the leaves.

items.lesson: Section A What are your favourite stories?
items.stem: 用括号里的词填空：Last weekend I ____ (go) to the beach and ____ (buy) a hat.
right: last weekend 说的是过去，用一般过去时；
go、buy 是不规则动词：went，bought。

ladder.q: I ____ (do) my homework last night.
We ____ (see) a movie and ____ (eat) pizza last night.
Yesterday they ____ (take) a bus and ____ (get) home at six.

items.lesson: Section B What can stories teach us?
items.stem: 读完 The Ugly Duckling，同学们争论他到底是什么鸟。哪个说法最站得住？
options: A swan. He saw himself in the lake.
A duck. He swam as well as the ducks.
A duck. Mother Duck said so.
right: 结尾他在湖水里看见：自己是一只白天鹅；
会游泳、鸭妈妈的话，都证明不了他是鸭子。
typical: 鸭妈妈说 He's still a duck，

ladder.q: What colour was the ugly duckling at first?
The other birds thought he was ugly. Were they right?
ladder.a: No. He was a beautiful swan.

ladder.q: He swam well. Does that prove he was a duck? Why?

items.lesson: Section A How do people spend their holidays ?
lessons: How do people spend their holidays
items.stem: We saw ____ in the museum.
right: 形容词修饰 something 等不定代词时放在后面；
肯定句用 something：something interesting。

ladder.q: 用 something 或 anything 填空：There's ____ (new) on the blackboard.
用 something 或 anything 填空：I didn't buy ____ (special) for myself.
I have ____ ____ to do today.（我今天没什么特别的事要做。）

items.lesson: Section B What can we learn from holiday experiences?
lessons: What can we learn from holiday experiences
items.topic: so 与 such 怎么选
items.stem: The film was ____ funny that we laughed all the way home. It was ____ a great evening!
right: funny 是形容词，前面用 so：so funny that…
a great evening 是名词短语，前面用 such：such a great evening。
typical: It was so a great evening!

ladder.q: 填 so 或 such：The soup is ____ hot that I can't eat it.
填 so 或 such：She is ____ a kind girl that everyone likes her.
用 such…that 合成一句：It was a hot day. We stayed at home.
ladder.a: It was such a hot day that we stayed at home.

items.lesson: Section A What can you do for your home?
lessons: What can you do for your home
items.stem: 你两手抱着书，想请同学帮你把灯打开。哪句说得最得体？
options: Could I turn on the light, please?
Could you please turned on the light?
Could you turn on the light, please?
right: 请别人帮你做事，用 Could you + 动词原形…?
Could you turn on the light, please?
typical: 想让灯亮，就问“能开灯吗”：
Could I turn on the light, please?

ladder.q: 填 I 或 you：Could ____ please sweep the floor?（请妈妈扫地）
填 I 或 you：Can ____ use your phone?（问朋友能不能借手机用）
想请哥哥擦窗户，改写这句：Could I clean the windows?
ladder.a: Could you clean the windows, please?

items.lesson: Section B How do you feel at home?
lessons: How do you feel at home
items.stem: —The rubbish bin is full. Could you help? —Sure, I'll ____ now.
right: take out 的宾语是代词时，代词要放在中间：
take it out（不能说 take out it）。
typical: 记住了 take out the rubbish，换成 it 也放在最后：

ladder.q: 用 it 改写：Please clean up the kitchen. → Please ____.
用 them 改写：Can you hang up the photos? → Can you ____?
—My books are all over the desk. —OK, I'll ____ (pack up) now.

items.lesson: Section A How are we different from each other?
lessons: How are we different from each other
items.stem: Tina is ____ than her sister.
right: 有 than，要用比较级；
outgoing 是多音节词，前面加 more：more outgoing。
typical: Tina is outgoinger than her sister.

ladder.q: Tom is ____ (tall) than Sam.
This book is ____ (interesting) than that one.
I'm ____ (good) at math than my brother, but he's ____ (funny).

items.lesson: Section B How do we understand differences?
items.stem: 小明这样理解下面这句话。你同意吗？
work: Mia is less outgoing than her sister.
小明：意思是姐姐比 Mia 更外向。
right: less + 形容词 + than 表示“不如……”：
Mia 不如姐姐外向，也就是姐姐比 Mia 更外向。

ladder.q: This box is less heavy than that one. 哪个箱子更重？
同义改写：Mia is less outgoing than her sister. = Mia is not as ____ as her sister.
用 less…than 写：我没有哥哥那么认真（serious）。
ladder.a: I am less serious than my brother.

items.lesson: Section A What can plants and animals do?
lessons: What can plants and animals do
items.stem: This is ____ movie theater in our town.
right: cheap 是单音节词，最高级加 -est；
最高级修饰名词，前面要加 the：the cheapest。
typical: 最高级就是在前面加 the most：

ladder.q: This is ____ (big) shop in our town.
Which is ____ (good) movie theater near here?
Of all the students, Mike is ____ (funny).

items.lesson: Section B How are plants and animals connected with us?
lessons: How are plants and animals connected with us
items.stem: 用 important 的名词形式填空：Bees show us the ____ of small animals.
right: the ____ of 中间要填名词；
important 的名词是 importance（-ant 变 -ance）。

ladder.q: 写出名词：dark → ____
写出名词：active → ____
用 invent 的适当形式填空：The ____ of paper changed the world.

items.lesson: Section A How do we make food?
items.stem: ____ bananas and ____ milk do we need?
right: bananas 可数，用 how many；
milk 不可数，用 how much。
typical: 牛奶也能一杯一杯地数：
How many bananas and how many milk…?

ladder.q: ____ yogurt do we need?
____ apples do you want?
____ cups of milk do we need?

items.lesson: Section B What does cooking give us?
items.stem: 用英语写在纸上：三瓶牛奶
right: milk 不可数，复数加在量词 bottle 上：
three bottles of milk
typical: 汉语“三瓶”的“瓶”不变，英语照搬：

ladder.q: 用英语写：两碗米饭
用英语写：五片面包
We need ____（三袋面粉）and ____（两勺糖）.
ladder.a: three bags of flour；two spoons of sugar

items.lesson: Section A When do we make plans?
items.stem: Jack plans ____ a movie tonight. He enjoys ____ action movies.
right: plan 后接 to do：plans to watch；
enjoy 后接 doing：enjoys watching。
typical: 两个空都跟 plan 一样用 to do：

ladder.q: I hope ____ (see) you again.
My parents enjoy ____ (watch) the news after dinner.
She enjoys ____ (read), and she wants ____ (learn) French.

items.lesson: Section A When do we make plans?
items.stem: “他长大后打算当医生。”He ____ a doctor when he grows up.
right: be going to + 动词原形；“当”要用 be：
He is going to be a doctor.
typical: He is going to a doctor.

ladder.q: 用 be going to 填空：I ____ (visit) my grandparents this weekend.
—What ____ you going to ____ when you grow up? —An engineer.
改成一般疑问句：They're going to be teachers.
ladder.a: Are they going to be teachers?

items.lesson: Section B How can we make good plans?
lessons: How can we make good plans
items.stem: Tom makes a study plan every week, but he hardly ever follows it. 意思是？
options: 他很努力地按计划去做
他几乎从来不按计划做
right: hardly ever = almost never，“几乎从不”：
他每周都订计划，却几乎从来不照着做。
typical: hardly 是 hard 加 -ly，“努力地”：
他很努力地按计划去做。

ladder.q: hardly ever 和哪个意思相同：always / almost never / often？
He is very busy, so he ____ ____ watches TV.（他几乎从不看电视）
按频率从高到低排：hardly ever, always, sometimes, usually

items.lesson: Section A What are your predictions about the future?
lessons: What are your predictions about the future
items.stem: “将来会有更多的机器人。”哪句对？
right: there be 的将来时是 there will be，
will 后用原形 be：There will be more robots.

ladder.q: There ____ ____ a test tomorrow.
—____ there be robots in every home? —Yes, there will.
People ____ (have) robots at home in 50 years.

items.lesson: Section B How can we prepare for the future?
lessons: How can we prepare for the future
items.stem: In the future, there will be ____ cars on the road and ____ pollution.
right: cars 可数，用 fewer；
pollution 不可数，用 less。
typical: less cars on the road and less pollution

ladder.q: 填 fewer 或 less：I want to eat ____ sugar.
填 fewer 或 less：There are ____ students in Class 2 than in Class 1.
We should drink ____ sugary drinks and eat ____ fast food.

items.lesson: Section A How do we communicate?
items.stem: 朋友邀请小明，小明这样回答。你同意吗？
work: —Can you come to my birthday party this Friday?
—Sure, I'd love.
right: I'd love to. 是 I'd love to come. 的省略，
to 不能省：Sure, I'd love to.

ladder.q: —Would you like to go hiking? —Yes, I'd like ____.
—Can you go to the movies with us? —I'd love ____, but I have to study.
—Can you help me with my English? —I'd be glad ____.

items.lesson: Section A How do we communicate?
items.stem: 用 if 把 It will rain tomorrow. 和 We will stay at home. 连成一句。小明从第几步开始错？
work: “明天下雨”是条件，用 if 引出
从句照搬原句：If it will rain tomorrow,
主句用一般将来时：we will stay at home.
合起来：If it will rain tomorrow, we will stay at home.
right: if 条件句“主将从现”：if 句用一般现在时，
If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.

ladder.q: If you ____ (study) hard, you'll pass the test.
If it ____ (be) sunny tomorrow, we ____ (go) hiking.
If she ____ (not get) up early, she ____ (miss) the bus.

items.lesson: Section B How can we communicate better?
items.stem: My classmates lent me their notes after I missed the class. They were easy to read. They 指什么？
right: They 是复数，“容易读”的是笔记：
They = their notes。
typical: They 离 the class 最近，
所以 They 指那节课。

ladder.q: I bought a new kite. It flies very high. It 指什么？
My parents gave me two books. I put them on my desk. them 指什么？
Tom asked Amy for help, and she said yes. Then he thanked her. she、her 各指谁？

items.lesson: Section A How do you spend your free time?
lessons: How do you spend your free time
items.stem: “为了保持健康，爷爷每天早上游泳。”Grandpa swims every morning ____.
right: 说明“为了做某事”，用动词不定式 to do：
Grandpa swims every morning to keep fit.
typical: Grandpa swims every morning for keep fit.

ladder.q: I got up early ____ (catch) the first bus.
填 to 或 for：Tom went to the shop ____ some milk and then went home ____ cook dinner.
用不定式说明目的：我存钱是为了买一把吉他。
ladder.a: I save money to buy a guitar.

items.lesson: Section A How do you spend your free time?
lessons: How do you spend your free time
items.stem: 小林给同桌推荐一个视频，这样写。你同意吗？
work: This funny video will make you laugh.
right: make 后的宾语补足语用不带 to 的动词原形：
make you laugh，这句话没有错。

ladder.q: Please let me ____ (carry) the box for you.
The coach asked us ____ (run) faster, and he made us ____ (practise) every day.
改错：The sad movie made my mum to cry.
ladder.a: 去掉 to：made my mum cry

items.lesson: Section B How can a hobby improve your life?
lessons: How can a hobby improve your life
items.topic: 分清句子是事实还是观点
items.stem: 小林读一篇介绍爱好的短文，这样判断下面这句话。你同意吗？
work: Painting is the most relaxing hobby.
小林：这是观点——说的是一种看法，没法证明一定对。
right: 事实能查证；观点是看法，可能对也可能不对。
这句没有 think，但“最放松”因人而异，所以是观点。

ladder.q: 写 F（事实）或 O（观点）：Amy has collected 50 stamps.
写 F 或 O：① Collecting stamps is boring. ② Amy keeps her stamps in a blue box.
不用 think、believe，写一句关于集邮的观点。
ladder.a: 如 Collecting stamps is the best hobby.（是看法即可）

items.lesson: Section A What should we do when we don't feel well?
lessons: What should we do when we don't feel well
items.stem: 填一个词：“这对双胞胎是自学弹吉他的。”The twins taught ____ to play the guitar.
right: 主语 the twins 是复数，“他们自己”用复数反身代词：
them + selves = themselves。
typical: myself、yourself 是物主代词加 self，
所以“他们自己”= their + selves：theirselves

ladder.q: 写出反身代词：he → ____，she → ____，they → ____
The little girl can dress ____ now.
—Did your parents enjoy ____ at the party? —Yes, they had a great time.

items.lesson: Section B How should we stay safe?
items.stem: 护士说：“Don't worry. The test is painless.” 她的意思是这项检查——
right: 后缀 -less 表示“没有”（without）：
pain + less = without pain，painless 就是“不痛的”。

ladder.q: This small snake is harmless. harmless 是什么意思？
My old phone doesn't work at all. It's ____ (use) now.
Ben left hot oil on the stove and walked away. That was ____ (care) of him.

items.lesson: Section A What makes you upset?
items.stem: 用 although 把 Lucy failed the test. 和 She didn't give up. 连成一句。小明从第几步开始错？
work: 两句是转折：没考好，却没放弃
although 放在“没考好”这句前面
后句表示转折，前面再加上 but
Although Lucy failed the test, but she didn't give up.
right: although 和 but 只能用一个：
Although Lucy failed the test, she didn't give up.

ladder.q: 用 but 改写：Although it was late, Dad was still working.
ladder.a: It was late, but Dad was still working.

ladder.q: 改错：Although Tom was tired, but he finished his homework.
用 although 说一句：虽然这本书很长，我还是一天就读完了。
ladder.a: Although the book was long, I finished it in a day.

items.lesson: Section A What makes you upset?
items.stem: “雨停了我们才出发。”哪句对？
options: We will leave until the rain stops.
We won't leave until the rain will stop.
We won't leave until the rain stops.
right: leave 是一下子的动作，雨停前“不走”，用 not … until；
We won't leave until the rain stops.（until 句用一般现在时）
typical: “才出发”是肯定的，就用 will leave：
We will leave until the rain stops.

ladder.q: “昨晚我直到十点才睡觉。”I ____ go to bed ____ ten o'clock last night.
“妈妈回来我们才吃饭。”We won't eat ____ Mum ____ (come) back.
用 until 翻译：直到铃响，他才写完试卷。
ladder.a: He didn't finish the test until the bell rang.

items.lesson: Section B How can we stay positive?
items.stem: After the game, Leo felt blue all evening. felt blue 的意思是——
right: feel blue 是习语，意思是“心情低落、不开心”；
习语的意思不等于每个词的意思相加。
typical: blue 是“蓝色”，feel blue 就是脸色发青：
Leo 一晚上都冻得发青。

ladder.q: 哪个和 feel blue 意思相反：in high spirits / in low spirits？
Mum asked Lily, “Why the long face?” 妈妈在问什么？
选习语填空（a heavy heart / on top of the world）：She won first prize and felt ____.

items.lesson: Section A What is amazing about nature?
items.stem: “下山时，爸爸走得比我更小心。”On the way down, Dad walked ____ than I did.
right: 比的是“走”的样子，要用副词 carefully；
多音节副词的比较级前加 more：more carefully。
typical: Dad walked more careful than I did.

ladder.q: Tom runs ____ (fast) than his brother.
Sally sings ____ (beautiful) than the other girls in her class.
用比较级翻译：李华英语说得比她哥哥更流利。
ladder.a: Li Hua speaks English more fluently than her brother (does).

items.lesson: Section B Why do we explore nature?
items.topic: How 后面接哪个形容词
items.stem: 填两个词：—____ ____ is Lake Baikal? —It's about 1,620 metres deep.
right: 答语说的是 deep（深），问“多深”就用 How deep；
How 后面的形容词要和答语里的形容词对上。
typical: 问多少米就用 How long：

ladder.q: —____ ____ is the tree? —It's about 20 metres tall.
—____ ____ is the nearest hospital? —About 3 kilometres away.
—____ ____ will the bus come? —In ten minutes.

items.lesson: Section A What happens during a natural disaster?
lessons: What happens during a natural disaster
items.topic: 过去进行时：当时正在做
items.stem: “去年地震发生时，叔叔阿姨正在院子里干活。”When the earthquake hit last year, my aunt and uncle ____ in the garden.
right: 地震那一刻，叔叔阿姨正在干活，用过去进行时；
主语是复数，用 were：were working。
typical: my aunt and uncle worked in the garden.

ladder.q: At eight last night, I ____ (watch) a movie with my family.
—What ____ your friends ____ (do) when the storm started?
When the lights went out, my parents ____ (talk) and I ____ (have) a shower.

items.lesson: Section A What happens during a natural disaster?
lessons: What happens during a natural disaster
items.stem: 小红这样写上周一节体育课上的事。你同意吗？
work: While lightning hit a tree, we were having PE.
right: while 后面要接持续一段时间的动作；
闪电一下子就击中了树，要用 when：
When lightning hit a tree, we were having PE.

ladder.q: 填 when 或 while：____ the teacher came in, we were still talking.
用 while 连成一句：I was walking in the park. I met my English teacher.
ladder.a: While I was walking in the park, I met my English teacher.

ladder.q: 改错：While I got home, Mum was cooking dinner.
ladder.a: While → When（或 While Mum was cooking dinner, I got home.）

items.lesson: Section B What can we do to prepare for the worst?
lessons: What can we do to prepare for the worst
items.stem: “去年那个小镇发生了一场大地震。”A big earthquake ____ in the town last year.
right: happen（发生）不用被动语态，主语是事情也直接用它；
去年发生的事用过去式：happened。
typical: 地震不是自己做的事，要用被动：
A big earthquake was happened in the town.

ladder.q: A big fire ____ (happen) in the forest last week.
改错：The accident was happened near our school.
The flood ____ (take place) in our village in 2020.

items.lesson: Section A How different are our cultures?
items.stem: At a French friend's home, Zhou Lin got a kiss on the cheek. It was ____ to her, and she felt a little ____.
right: “这件事让人惊讶”用 -ing：It was surprising；
“她感到尴尬”用 -ed：she felt a little embarrassed。
typical: “尴尬的”就是 embarrassing，说人说事都一样：

ladder.q: The story was so ____ (bore) that I fell asleep.
We were ____ (excite) when we heard the news.
The rules were ____ (confuse), so all the new students felt ____ (confuse).

items.lesson: Section A How different are our cultures?
items.stem: 小明想说“如果你不快点，就会迟到”，写了下面这句。你同意吗？
work: You will be late unless you don't hurry.
right: unless 本身就是“如果不”，后面不再加 not：
You will be late unless you hurry.

ladder.q: 用 unless 改写：If you don't leave now, you'll miss the train.
ladder.a: Unless you leave now, you'll miss the train.

ladder.q: 填 if 或 unless：Don't call me ____ it's really important.
用 unless 翻译：除非下雨，否则我们明天去爬山。
ladder.a: We'll go hiking tomorrow unless it rains.

items.lesson: Section B How do we show respect to other cultures?
lessons: How do we show respect to other cultures
items.topic: 否定前缀 un- 还是 im-
items.stem: 加前缀写出反义词：In France, it's ____ (polite) to ask a new friend how old they are.
right: polite 的反义词是 impolite；
p 开头的词常用 im-：impossible、improper、impatient。

ladder.q: 写反义词：possible → ____
Jeans are too ____ (formal) for a wedding.
My brother never waits for anyone. He is so ____ (patient).

items.lesson: Section A What great books have you read?
lessons: What great books have you read
items.stem: “我已经写完读书报告了，但还没给老师看。”I've ____ written my book report, but I haven't shown it to my teacher ____.
right: 肯定句说“已经”用 already，放在 have 后面；
否定句说“还没”用 yet，放在句末。
typical: I haven't shown it to my teacher already.

ladder.q: 填 already 或 yet：The movie has ____ started, but Tom hasn't arrived ____.
—Have you had lunch ____? —Yes, I've ____ had it.
用 already 或 yet 翻译：我还没给奶奶回信。
ladder.a: I haven't written back to Grandma yet.（或 replied to）

items.lesson: Section B What can we learn from great books?
lessons: What can we learn from great books
items.stem: Lily 的故事按顺序有三件事。画故事山（plot）时，哪件事是高潮（climax）？
options: Lily's cat runs away one rainy night.
Lily finds her cat under a car.
Lily and her cat sleep safely at home.
right: 猫跑丢是难题出现，后面还要去找；
找到猫，难题在这一刻解决，是故事的最高点——高潮。
typical: 所以高潮是 Lily's cat runs away.

ladder.q: 按顺序排：climax, beginning, ending, build-up, problem
