Ben's kite gets stuck in a tree. At last his dad gets it down. They fly it again. 哪句是高潮？
ladder.a: At last his dad gets it down.

ladder.q: 补一句高潮：Max gets lost in a big shop. He looks everywhere. ____ They go home together.
ladder.a: 如 At last he finds his mum.（难题在这里解决）

items.lesson: Section A What can we do to help?
lessons: What can we do to help
items.stem: “林慧加入学校读书社已经两年了。”Lin Hui ____ a member of the school reading club for two years.
right: “加入”是一下子的动作，become 不能和 for two years 连用；
说“是会员两年了”，用能持续的 be：has been a member。
typical: Lin Hui has become a member for two years.

ladder.q: Tom bought this camera two years ago. → Tom has ____ this camera for two years.
改错：Mr Li has come to our school for three years.
ladder.a: has come to → has been at

ladder.q: Uncle Wang left Beijing three years ago. → Uncle Wang has ____ ____ from Beijing for three years.

items.lesson: Section B How does helping others make a difference?
lessons: How does helping others make a difference
items.stem: “这次救援很成功。”The rescue was very ____.
right: was very 后面说救援“怎么样”，要用形容词 successful；
success 是名词，successfully 修饰动作。

ladder.q: The school concert was a great ____ (succeed).
They ____ (successful) found the lost boy that night.
Lisa wants to be a ____ (succeed) writer. She tried hard and ____ (succeed) at last.

items.lesson: Section A What changes have taken place around you?
lessons: What changes have taken place around you
items.stem: Great changes ____ in my hometown since 2015.
right: since 2015 说的是从那时到现在，用现在完成时；
主语 changes 是复数，用 have；take place 没有被动。
typical: 变化是“被带来的”，要用被动：

ladder.q: My town ____ (change) a lot in the past ten years.
What ____ (happen) to your hometown since you left?
改错：A big change has been taken place in my school.

items.lesson: Section A What changes have taken place around you?
lessons: What changes have taken place around you
items.stem: 小明这样写家乡的变化。你同意吗？
work: A big supermarket has opened in my village two years ago.
right: two years ago 是过去的一个时间点，要用一般过去时：
A big supermarket opened in my village two years ago.

ladder.q: We ____ (move) to this town in 2018.
My hometown ____ (change) a lot since I was a child.
The new bridge ____ (open) last year, and many people ____ (use) it since then.

items.lesson: Section A What changes have taken place around you?
lessons: What changes have taken place around you
items.stem: 用括号里的词填空：My grandpa used to ____ (ride) a bike to work. Now he takes the subway.
right: used to + 动词原形，表示过去常常做、现在不做了：
used to ride。
typical: used 是过去式，后面也用过去式：rode

ladder.q: There used to ____ (be) a river here.
用 used to 改写：Tom often played football, but he doesn't now.
用 used to 说一句：这座小镇以前很安静，现在很热闹。
ladder.a: This town used to be quiet. Now it's busy.

items.lesson: Section A What changes have taken place around you?
lessons: What changes have taken place around you
items.topic: 完成时配 for 还是 since
items.stem: My grandparents have lived in this town ____.
right: have lived 说的是一直住到现在，后面接一段时间用 for：for 50 years；
since 后面接时间点：since 1976；ago 只配一般过去时。
typical: have lived in this town since 50 years

ladder.q: 填 for 或 since：We have lived in this city ____ 2018.
填 for 或 since：My father has worked in this hospital ____ ten years.
填 for 或 since：My grandpa has lived here ____ he was a child.

items.lesson: Section B How do changes influence us?
items.topic: 读懂 used to 的意思
items.stem: 读句子：My town used to have only one small shop. 这句话的意思是：
options: 镇上一直到今天都只有一家小商店
镇上的人早就习惯那家小商店了
镇上把那家小商店用来干别的
过去只有一家小商店，现在不同了
right: used to + 动词原形：过去常常是这样，现在不再这样；
读报道时，used to 后面常接着 now 说现在的样子。
typical: used to 就是“常常”：镇上一直只有一家小商店

ladder.q: There used to be a river here. 现在这里还有河吗？
ladder.a: 没有了（以前有，现在没有）

ladder.q: 哪句说“现在习惯早起”？A. I used to get up early. B. I am used to getting up early.
用 used to 和 now 写两句：以前骑车上学，现在坐公交。
ladder.a: I used to ride a bike to school. Now I take a bus.

items.lesson: Section B How do changes influence us?
items.stem: 小林写 Changes in My Life，写了四句。他从第几句开始用错时态？
work: In primary school, I used to go home for lunch.
Now I have lunch at school with my classmates.
Since I started junior high, I learned to cook.
I have grown taller, so my old bike is too small.
right: 第 3 句有 since，说的是从上初中一直到现在，要用现在完成时：
Since I started junior high, I have learned to cook.

ladder.q: My family ____ (live) in this flat since 2020.
We ____ (move) to a bigger flat last year.
改错：Since I came to this school, I joined two clubs.
